# Muscle Strain
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on March 10, 2022 at 11:32 AM GMT+2
## On this page
  * [What are Musculoskeletal Strains?](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#what-are-musculoskeletal-strains)
  * [Causes](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#causes)
  * [Risks](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#risks)
  * [Symptoms](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#symptoms)
    * [Grading of Strains](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#grading-of-strains)
  * [Diagnosis](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#diagnosis)
    * [Patient History and Physical Examination](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#patient-history-and-physical-examination)
    * [Imaging](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#imaging)
  * [Treatment](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#treatment)
    * [Conservative Treatment](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#conservative-treatment)
    * [Medical Treatment](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#medical-treatment)
    * [Side Effects of NSAIDs](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#side-effects-of-nsaids)
  * [Prevention](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#prevention)
  * [Prognosis](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#prognosis)


* * *
Share this article:
This article contains self-care information for the selected condition. If you have questions or need more comprehensive treatment advice, please consult a medical professional.
## What are Musculoskeletal Strains?
A strain is an injury to either a muscle or tendon (fibrous cords of tissue that connect muscle to bone) and is a common musculoskeletal condition. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Strains can be caused by twisting or pulling these tissues.
Muscle strains can be acute, sudden and severe in the beginning, or chronic, persisting for a long time or constantly recurring. Typical forms of musculoskeletal strains are:
  * Back strain
  * Hip strain
  * Wrist strain
  * Ankle strain
  * Calf muscle strain


The most common form is muscle strain in the back. Symptoms may include pain, swelling, muscle spasms, and reduced ability to move a muscle. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Treatment of strains includes conservative measures at the initial phase; this consists of resting the injured area and applying ice and compression with a bandage. Treatment with medication is also possible. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [2](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2").
If you think you or a beloved one may be experiencing symptoms of muscle strain, get a symptom assessment with the 
## Causes of Strains
Muscle strains most commonly occur in the setting of increased eccentric muscle load on the body. Eccentric force is when muscles contract while elongating, resulting in excessive force and damage. [3](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
Injuries to the muscle or tendon can present in 2 forms, either suddenly or developing over time. A strain injury can result from twisting or pulling a muscle or tendon. An acute strain is associated with recent trauma or injury. It also can occur after lifting heavy objects or over-stressing the muscles.
Chronic strains are caused mainly by muscle overuse due to too much physical activity, inadequate warming up before physical activity or poor flexibility. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Repetitive movement of the muscles and tendons can lead to a prolonged injury.
The most common sites are back and hamstring muscles. Many people get strains from playing sports. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
## Risk Factors
Participating in team sports and court games can increase the chance of developing a strain. Other risk factors can include: [3](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") [5](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * Age
  * Previous history of strain injury
  * Anatomical variation of muscle and tendons
  * Eccentric exercise
  * Individuals who are starting physical activity for the first time
  * Not warming up before commencing physical activity.


## Symptoms of Muscle Strains
The symptoms of musculoskeletal strains can differ depending on the anatomic location and severity of the injury. These can include: [1](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [2](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3"):
  * Sudden pain when contracting the muscle
  * Swelling
  * Bruising
  * Loss of strength
  * Impaired range of motion in the affected area.


### Grading of Strains
The severity of a strain may be assessed by a medical professional. [6](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
  1. First-degree strains (mildest form)


  * not much tissue tearing
  * mild tenderness
  * pain with a full range of motion.


  1. Second-degree strains


  * torn muscle or tendon tissues
  * painful, limited motion
  * possibly some swelling or depression at the spot of the injury.


  1. Third-degree strains (most severe)


  * limited or no movement
  * pain will be severe at first but possibly painless after the initial injury.


## Diagnosis of Strains
Diagnosis of muscle strains relies on the history of the mechanism of injury and clinical examination. Imaging investigations can also be used as a tool to confirm the diagnosis. [3](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") [7](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7")
### Patient History and Physical Examination
Diagnosis of strains begins with a consultation with a doctor, where they may ask questions regarding the history of the injury. These may include: [3](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
  * What is the symptom
  * When did the symptom begin, and how did it occur
  * Any additional symptoms that you are currently experiencing
  * Previous history of injury, how it was managed and what were the outcomes.


### Imaging
  * Ultrasound[4](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") [7](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7")
  * X-Ray
  * MRI[7](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7") It can be requested in cases where ultrasound is insufficient.


## Muscle Strain Treatment
Most muscle strains in clinical practice do not require surgery; a full recovery can almost always be expected. The initial approach to treating musculoskeletal strains is conservative methods that can be combined with medical therapy.
### Conservative Treatment
The first step in treating strains is to initiate PRICE protocol[8](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") [9](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9")
  * P
  * R
  * I
  * C
  * E


### Medical Treatment
Drug therapy may not be necessary but can be used to control symptoms of pain and inflammation. It's important to always consult your doctor before starting any medication.
Paracetamol[10](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs)ibuprofennaproxen[8](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") [9](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") [11](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11")
### Side Effects of NSAIDs
Like all medications, NSAIDs do have side effects. These are more common if you're taking high doses for a long time or are elderly or in poor general health. [11](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11") Possible side effects include:
  * Indigestion
  * Stomach ulcer
  * Headaches
  * Drowsiness
  * Dizziness
  * Allergic reactions


In rare cases, liver, kidney, heart or blood circulation problems can arise, such as heart failure, heart attack and strokes. If you are experiencing any side effects, it's recommended that you stop taking any medication and consult with your doctor.
## Prevention
Musculoskeletal strain injury can happen to everyone. However, some preventive methods can reduce the risk of injury: [12](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-strain/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12")
  * Use protective gear in contact sports
  * Maintain flexibility and strength of muscles
  * Warming up thoroughly before starting any physical activity
  * Wearing appropriate shoes for the specific physical activity.


## Find out more about your symptoms
## Prognosis
The outcome of musculoskeletal strains depends on the grade of injury [14].
  * Grade I strains
  * Grade II strains
  * Grade III strains


Guidelines for Americans](https://health.gov/sites/default/files/2019-09/Physical_Activity_Guidelines_2nd_edition.pdf). Accessed February 7, 2022.

# Trockene Augen (Keratokonjunktivitis sicca)
Verfasst von [Adas medizinischem Fachpersonal](https://ada.com/de/team/medical/)
Aktualisiert am 15. Februar 2022 um 10:00 OEZ
## Auf dieser Seite
  * [Was sind trockene Augen (Keratokonjunktivitis sicca)?](https://ada.com/de/conditions/keratoconjunctivitis-sicca/#was-sind-trockene-augen-keratokonjunktivitis-sicca)
  * [Risiken](https://ada.com/de/conditions/keratoconjunctivitis-sicca/#risiken)
  * [Symptome](https://ada.com/de/conditions/keratoconjunctivitis-sicca/#symptome)
  * [Diagnose](https://ada.com/de/conditions/keratoconjunctivitis-sicca/#diagnose)
  * [Behandlung](https://ada.com/de/conditions/keratoconjunctivitis-sicca/#behandlung)
  * [Prognose](https://ada.com/de/conditions/keratoconjunctivitis-sicca/#prognose)
  * [Vorsorge](https://ada.com/de/conditions/keratoconjunctivitis-sicca/#vorsorge)


* * *
Artikel teilen:
## Was sind trockene Augen (Keratokonjunktivitis sicca)?
Keratoconjunctivitis sicca ist eine häufige Erkrankung, die auch als Syndrom des trockenen Auges bekannt ist. Es kann auftreten, wenn weniger Tränen als üblich produziert werden, sich die Tränen nicht richtig über das Auge verteilen oder zu schnell trocknen.
In einigen Fällen tritt es zusammen mit anderen Krankheiten oder nach Einnahme bestimmter Medikamente auf. Manchmal ist keine offensichtliche Ursache zu finden. Diese Erkrankung ist bei älteren Menschen am meisten verbreitet und Betroffene haben oft trockene, juckende und rote Augen, sowie eine verschwommene Sicht.
Trockene Augen werden mit Augentropfen behandelt und wenn eine Ursache gefunden wird, wird diese auch behandelt. Um trockene Augen zu verhindern, sollte trockene Luft und Wind vermieden und wenn nötig eine (Schutz-)Brille getragen werden. Viele Betroffene mit trockenen Augen können die Ursache behandeln, oder, wenn keine Ursache gefunden werden kann, können Betroffene lernen, mit ihren Symptomen umzugehen.
Hast Du oder eine andere Person Symptome, die auf diese Erkrankung hinweisen könnten? Starte jetzt eine kostenlose Symptomanalyse mit der [Adas Symptom-Checker](https://ada.com/de/app/) funktioniert.
## Was sind Risiken bei trockenen Augen?
Das Auge ist normalerweise von einem dünnen Tränenfilm bedeckt, der das Auge schützt. Das Syndrom des trockenen Auges kann auftreten, wenn weniger Tränen als üblich produziert werden, sich die Tränen nicht richtig über das Auge verteilen oder zu schnell trocknen.
Viele Ursachen kommen dafür in Frage, z.B.:
  * Krankheiten wie [Diabetes](https://ada.com/de/conditions/diabetes-mellitus-type-2/) (Zuckerkrankheit),
  * [systemischer Lupus erythematodes (SLE)](https://ada.com/de/conditions/systemic-lupus-erythematosus/),
  * Sklerodermie,
  * [rheumatoide Arthritis](https://ada.com/de/conditions/rheumatoid-arthritis/) oder
  * Amyloidose.


Trockene Luft oder Wind können ebenfalls die Augen austrocknen. Veränderungen des Hormonspiegels durch die Einnahme der Pille (orales Verhütungsmittel) oder die [Menopause](https://ada.com/de/conditions/menopause/) sind bei manchen Frauen die Ursache. Außerdem können Medikamente, wie einige Blutdruck-Senker, Antihistaminika oder Antidepressiva zu trockenen Augen führen. Die Erkrankung tritt mit zunehmendem Alter häufiger auf.
## Was sind Symptome bei trockenen Augen?
Allgemeine Symptome der Keratoconjunctivitis sicca sind:
  * ein kratzendes Gefühl im Auge,
  * juckende Augen,
  * verschwommene Sicht,
  * Rötung der Augen und
  * Lichtempfindlichkeit.


Dies kann ein oder beide Augen betreffen. Bei Betroffenen ermüden die Augen stark bei der Arbeit am Computer und am Schreibtisch.
## Wie werden trockene Augen diagnostiziert?
Die Diagnose wird durch eine Untersuchung der Augenoberfläche gestellt. Zusätzlich wird die Menge der Tränenflüssigkeit über einen bestimmten Zeitraum gemessen. Eventuell werden weitere Tests benötigt, um die Ursachen der trockenen Augen zu untersuchen.
## Wie werden trockene Augen behandelt?
Die Behandlung zielt auf die Symptome und die zugrunde liegende Ursache ab. Augentropfen können das kratzende, gereizte Gefühl lindern. Zudem sollten Rauch, Staub, trockene Luft und Augen-Make-Up vermieden werden.
Menschen mit Kontaktlinsen sollten sich an ihren Arzt oder Optiker wenden, um festzustellen, ob die Kontaktlinsen gemieden werden sollten. Ist eine zugrunde liegende Krankheit für die Symptome verantwortlich, sollte diese behandelt werden.
## Wie sieht die Prognose bei trockenen Augen aus?
Die Prognose ist recht gut, wenn die Erkrankung frühzeitig erkannt wird und die Ursache behandelt werden kann. Treten die Symptome infolge einer dauerhaften medizinischen Erkrankung auf, ist es möglicherweise schwierig, sie zu lindern. In einigen Fällen entwickeln Menschen, die über einen langen Zeitraum unter trockenen Augen leiden, Kratzer auf der Hornhaut (äußeres Auge), die die Sehkraft beeinträchtigen.
## Kann man trockenen Augen vorbeugen?
Das Austrocknen der Augen kann verhindert werden, indem trockene Luft und Wind gemieden werden. Eine Sonnenbrille oder eine Schutzbrille können auch dabei helfen, die Augen vor Wind zu schützen und ein zu schnelles Trocknen der Tränen zu verhindern.
## Finde mehr über Deine Symptome heraus

  * [Other names for viral meningitis](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#other-names-for-viral-meningitis)

## What is viral meningitis?
Viral meningitis, or aseptic meningitis, is a viral infection of the meninges, which are the membranes around the brain and spinal cord.[1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [2](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Think you might be experiencing viral meningitis
There are a number of common viruses that can cause viral meningitis. Symptoms include headache, nausea, vomiting, irritability, loss of appetite and drowsiness.
Viral meningitis is most common in newborns, young children and people with weakened immune systems. Although most people do not require any specific treatment for viral meningitis, some may need antiviral medications. The prognosis for someone with viral meningitis is generally good.
### Viral meningitis vs. bacterial meningitis
Whereas viral meningitis is caused by a virus, bacterial meningitis is caused by certain bacterial infections and can be far more serious than viral meningitis. Bacterial meningitis includes the potentially lethal meningococcal disease.[3](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
[Read more about Bacterial Meningitis »](https://ada.com/conditions/bacterial-meningitis/)
If you are worried that you or someone you know may have this condition, use the symptom checker works.
## Symptoms of viral meningitis
Typical symptoms of viral meningitis include: [1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [5](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [6](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
  * Fever
  * [Headache](https://ada.com/conditions/headache/)

  * Stiff neck
  * Nausea
  * Vomiting
  * Lack of appetite
  * Feeling sleepy or having trouble waking up
  * Lack of energy
  * Lack of coordination
  * Inability to concentrate


Symptoms in newborn babies and young children can include: [1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [5](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [7](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7") [8](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8")
  * Fever
  * Vomiting
  * Diarrhea
  * Stiff neck
  * Bulging fontanel, the soft spot on the head
  * Irritability
  * Restlessness
  * Lack of energy
  * Feeling sleepy or having trouble waking up
  * Being unwilling to feed
  * Muscle aches

  * Cough
  * [Jaundice](https://ada.com/conditions/neonatal-jaundice/)
  * Slightly red rash
  * [Seizures](https://ada.com/conditions/generalized-seizure/)


A person with viral meningitis may also show symptoms of the virus that is making them ill.[9](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") [10](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")
  * Skin rash
  * Runny nose
  * Sneezing
  * Cough
  * Aching muscles
  * Blisters in the mouth and throat

## Causes of viral meningitis
Viral meningitis is caused by various viruses that sometimes cause inflammation of the meninges, which are the membranes that surround the brain and spinal cord. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Good to know:
Viral meningitis is caused by various viruses that sometimes cause inflammation of the meninges, which are the membranes that surround the brain and spinal cord. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Non-polio enteroviruses cause 85 percent of cases of viral meningitis[common cold](https://ada.com/conditions/common-cold/) or produce no symptoms at all. Babies and people with compromised immune systems are most likely to develop complications, such as viral meningitis from an enterovirus. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [9](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") [10](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")
Herpes viruses, including the [herpes simplex virus](https://ada.com/conditions/herpes-simplex/) and [varicella zoster](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-varicella-zoster/) (chickenpox) virus, are the next most common cause of viral meningitis. Herpes simplex virus 2, or HSV-2, is more associated with viral meningitis. Herpes simplex-related cases of viral meningitis may cause Mollaret meningitis and can be very serious for newborn babies[11](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11") [12](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12")
[Mumps](https://ada.com/conditions/mumps/) and [measles](https://ada.com/conditions/measles/) can cause viral meningitis. Due to a fall in vaccination rates in some areas, viral meningitis caused by mumps and measles is most often seen in young adult populations[11](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11") [12](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12")
Other viruses that can cause viral meningitis include: [1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [11](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11") [12](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12") [13](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:13 "See Footnote 13") [14](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:14 "See Footnote 14") [15](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:15 "See Footnote 15")
  * Arboviruses such as West Nile virus and [dengue](https://ada.com/conditions/dengue-fever/)
  * Japanese B encephalitis
  * Tick-borne encephalitis
  * Cytomegalovirus, mainly of risk to people with weakened immune systems
  * [HIV](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/), occurring shortly after infection
  * Lymphocytic choriomeningitis, or LCM, which is carried by rodents


## Diagnosis of viral meningitis
Diagnosis is based on the symptoms, a physical examination and testing a sample of cerebrospinal fluid, which is a clear, colorless liquid in the brain and spinal cord.
The cerebrospinal fluid is taken in a procedure called a lumbar puncture,[16](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:16 "See Footnote 16") [17](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:17 "See Footnote 17")
The cerebrospinal fluid will be tested to assess whether the meningitis is viral or caused by another organism, and also to identify the virus responsible. These results will inform treatment. [5](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
In some cases, other samples may be needed to identify which virus is causing the meningitis. These samples can include: [1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [6](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
  * Blood
  * Throat or nose swab
  * Stool


Think you might be experiencing viral meningitis
## Treatment of viral meningitis
Most people with viral meningitis will recover without treatment within 7 to 10 days.[1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
An important early step in treating meningitis is to identify whether the condition is viral or bacterial in nature. As bacterial meningitis is typically more severe than the viral variety, it is likely that intravenous antibiotics will be promptly administered if it is suspected, even if it has not been fully confirmed through testing. Antibiotics are ineffective against viral meningitis.
If viral meningitis is caused by the herpes simplex virus, it should be treated intravenously with the antiviral drug acyclovir. [11](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11") [18](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:18 "See Footnote 18") If a person displays signs of disturbed consciousness or any other neurological problems, acyclovir should be administered early to halt the potential development of encephalitis. People in an unstable condition should be admitted to a critical care unit for airway protection, neurological checks, and in order to help reduce the possibility of secondary complications. Treatment methods may be altered, depending on the results of gram staining, cultures, and other tests.
Viral meningitis caused by enteroviruses or the herpes simplex virus is capable of causing viral septic shock in newborn babies and infants. For this reason, acyclovir and a broad range of other antiviral therapies should be introduced as soon as the diagnosis is suspected.
Antiretroviral drugs can be used to treat viral meningitis in people with HIV. [6](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
Good to know:
## Preventing viral meningitis
Protection against some viruses that cause viral meningitis can be obtained through vaccination, such as for mumps, measles, and varicella zoster. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
There are no vaccinations for enteroviruses,[1](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Using barrier devices, such as condoms, during sexual activity[2](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Taking precautions to avoid mosquito bites,[dengue](https://ada.com/conditions/dengue-fever/) and Japanese encephalitis, are primarily encountered while traveling. However, some mosquito-borne viruses, such as the West Nile virus, are found in the United States. [14](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:14 "See Footnote 14")
## Complications of viral meningitis
In rare cases, viral meningitis can cause more serious conditions. People most at risk include babies less than one month old and people with compromised immune systems.
Complications may include persistentand a feeling of general illness (malaise),Seizures
Viral meningitis caused by West Nile virus, Japanese B encephalitis, and tick-borne encephalitis can be life-threatening and cause long-term neurological problems. [11](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11")
Mollaret meningitis, also called Recurrent Lymphocytic Meningitis, is a rare form of viral meningitis that recurs repeatedly, separated by weeks or months without symptoms. People with Mollaret meningitis may also experience seizures, double vision, hallucinations, and other neurological problems. It is thought that the [herpes simplex virus](https://ada.com/conditions/herpes-simplex/) causes most cases. [17](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:17 "See Footnote 17")
### Long-term effects of viral meningitis
The majority of people who experience viral meningitis will experience no long-term effects as a result of the condition. There is research to suggest, however, that a small percentage of affected people may develop short-term memory loss and behavioral changes. Children under the age of one may also develop slight neurological problems later in life. [12](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12")
People concerned about the long-term effects of meningitis should talk to their doctor. 
### Neonatal herpes simplex meningitis
Herpes simplex virus affects around 1,500 to 2,000 newborn babies in the United States each year. If left untreated, the virus can cause viral meningitis. This condition can be life-threatening and can cause lasting brain damage. [18](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-meningitis/#fn:18 "See Footnote 18")
## Other names for viral meningitis
  * Aseptic meningitis
  * Viral meningoencephalitis

# Maumivu yangu ya kichwa yana maana gani?
[Harry](https://ada.com/sw/editorial/writers/harry-oconnor/)
Imehakikiwa kitiba
Imesasishwa tarehe 9 Aprili 2024, 11:50 GMT +2
Makadirio yanaonyesha kuwa 96% miongoni mwetu tumeshapatwa na maumivu ya kichwa wakati fulani.[1](https://ada.com/sw/editorial/what-does-my-headache-mean/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Kwa bahati mbaya, huo ndiyo ukweli ulivyo katika maisha. 
Isitoshe, kuelewa kinachosababisha maumivu ya kichwa inaweza kuwa ni changamoto kubwa. Kuna takriban aina 150 tofauti za maumivu ya kichwa
Embu tuone baadhi ya aina za kawaida za maumivu ya kichwa, yanaathiri sehemu gani ya kichwa, na yanaweza kuwa na maana gani.
Pakua app ya Ada bure ili kukagua dalili za maumivu ya kichwa.
## Aina za kawaida za maumivu ya kichwa na maeneo yake
### Maumivu ya pande zote mbili za kichwa 
Maumivu ya kichwa yanayoathiri pande zote mbili za kichwa huitwa maumivu ya kichwa ya aina ya msongo. Kwa kuwa hii ndiyo aina ya kawaida ya maumivu ya kichwa, inawezekana imeshawahi pia kukutokea. 
Watu mara nyingi huelezea maumivu ya kichwa ya msongo kama maumivu yasiyo makali na yenye kubana pande zote mbili za kichwa. Kwa kawaida, hayagongigongi. Badala yake, ni maumivu yalipooza na endelevu. Maumivu ya kichwa ya aina ya msongo kwa kawaida hudumu kwa angalau dakika 30 na yanaweza kuendelea kwa siku kadhaa. 
Baadhi ya visababishi vya kawaida vya maumivu ya kichwa ya msongo ni pamoja na
  * Kutolala vya kutosha 
  * Msongo 
  * Maumivu ya misuli katika kichwa na shingo 
  * Unywaji mwingi wa vinywaji vyenye kafeini 


Maumivu ya kichwa ya aina ya msongo mara nyingi huisha yenyewe na kwa kawaida siyo dalili ya ugonjwa fulani.
### Upande mmoja wa kichwa
#### Maumivu ya kipandauso (Migraine)
Kipandauso ni sababu ya kawaida ya maumivu ya kichwa yanayoathiri upande mmoja wa kichwa. Takriban mwanamke 1 kati ya 5 na mwanaume[2](https://ada.com/sw/editorial/what-does-my-headache-mean/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Kipandauso kwa kawaida husababisha maumivu ya kichwa yanayogonga upande mmoja pamoja na dalili nyingine zinazoweza kujumuisha:
  * Kichefuchefu na kutapika 
  * Kuathirika kirahisi na mwanga na sauti 
  * Ugumu wa kuzingatia mambo 


Pamoja na dalili tajwa, baadhi ya watu hupatwa na "aura" pindi wanapokabiliwa na maumivu ya kipandauso. Aura ni mvurugiko wa uwezo wa kuona, kuongea, na kuhisi ambao kwa kawaida hutokea kabla au wakati wa maumivu ya kipandauso. Kwa watu wengi, hali hiyo ni ishara za mwanzo kwamba wanakabiliwa na kipandauso. 
Vichocheo vya kipandauso hutofautiana baina ya watu walioathirika. Hata hivyo, kipandauso kinaweza kusababishwa na:
  * [Hedhi](https://ada.com/sw/editorial/mzunguko-wa-hedhi/)
  * Msongo 
  * Uchovu 
  * Baadhi ya vyakula na vinywaji


Maumivu yanaweza kudumu kwa muda wowote kuanzia saa 1 hadi siku 3.
#### Maumivu ya upande mmoja wa kichwa (Cluster headaches)
Maumivu ya upande mmoja wa kichwa kwa kawaida hutokea mara chache.
Mara nyingi maumivu husika huhisiwa karibu na tundu la jicho, na huwa ni makali ambayo hudumu kwa muda wa kati ya dakika 15 na masaa 3. Yanaweza kutokea mara kadhaa ndani ya siku moja. 
Wakati wa shambulizi la maumivu ya upande mmoja wa kichwa, mara nyingi watu huonekana kuwa ni [wenye wasiwasi](https://ada.com/sw/editorial/managing-anxiety/) au hasira. Wanaweza kuonyesha dalili zingine pia, zikiwemo:
  * Macho mekundu yenye machozi 
  * Kulegea na kuvimba kwa kope 1
  * Kunywea kwa mboni katika jicho 1
  * Kutokwa jasho usoni
  * Kuziba pua upande mmoja au kutokwa kamasi


Haifahamiki hasa ni nini husababisha maumivu makali ya upande mmoja wa kichwa, ingawa inaonekana kuna sababu ya kimaumbile, na watu wanaovuta sigara wanaweza kuwa katika hatari kubwa zaidi. 
### Mbele ya kichwa 
#### Maumivu ya kichwa ya sinasi (Sinus)
Maumivu ya kichwa karibu na macho, mashavu, na paji la uso yanaweza kutokea baada ya maambukizi ya virusi, [kama vile mafua](https://ada.com/sw/conditions/common-cold/), au wakati mtu ana homa inayosababishwa na vumbi au mizio. 
Maumivu ya kichwa ya sinasi mara nyingi huambatana na dalili nyingine, kama vile:
  * Pua kuziba 
  * Kutokwa kamasi puani 
  * Uchovu
  * Kupungua uwezo wa kunusa


Kwa kuwa maumivu ya kichwa ya sinasi na kipandauso yana dalili zinazofanana, inawezekana kuyachanganya. Tafiti zinaonyesha kwamba zaidi ya 90% ya maumivu ya kichwa ya sinasi kwa hakika husababishwa na kipandauso. [3](https://ada.com/sw/editorial/what-does-my-headache-mean/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") Maumivu ya kichwa ya sinasi kwa kawaida hudumu kwa muda mrefu kuliko maumivu ya kipandauso, na mara nyingi hudumu kwa siku kadhaa kwa wakati mmoja. Pia, baadhi ya dalili za kipandauso, kama vile kichefuchefu na aura, haziambatani na maumivu ya kichwa ya sinasi. 
### Maumivu ya kichwa yanayosababishwa na kuacha kunywa kafeini 
Unaweza kuhisi maumivu eneo la mbele kichwani ikiwa utapunguza ghafla unywaji wako wa kafeini.
Mara nyingi huanza kama maumivu na shinikizo nyuma ya macho, maumivu ya kichwa ya kafeini yanaweza kufika hadi kwenye paji la uso. 
Maumivu ya kichwa yanayosababishwa na kuacha kunywa kafeini siyo makali na huisha baada ya siku chache. Ikiwa unajaribu kupunguza unywaji wa kafeini, ni vizuri kufanya hivyo hatua kwa hatua ili kuepuka kuhisi maumivu ya kichwa yanayosababishwa na kuacha kunywa kafeini.
Pakua kikagua dalili chetu.
## Kichwa na shingo nzima
Maumivu ya kichwa yanayogonga ghafla kama mlipuko wa radi (thunderclap headaches) huathiri kichwa na shingo nzima. Ni maumivu makali, na watu wanaopata aina hii ya maumivu ya kichwa mara nyingi huyaelezea kama "maumivu ya kichwa mabaya kuliko yote katika maisha yao."
Watu wanaopatwa na maumivu ya kichwa ya "thunderclap" wanaweza pia kuhisi kichefuchefu, kutapika, na kutoshahimili mwanga mkali.
Maumivu ya kichwa ya "thunderclap" inaweza kuwa ni dalili ya kuvuja kwa damu katika ubongo na utando unaozunguka eneo hilo (subarachnoid hemorrhage), ambayo ni hali inayohitaji matibabu ya dharura. Ikiwa unahisi ukabiliwa na maumivu ya kichwa ya aina hii, unapaswa kutafuta msaada wa matibabu ya dharura. 
## Kutibu maumivu ya kichwa nyumbani 
Kuna mambo kadhaa unaweza kufanya ili kupunguza maumivu ya kichwa. Yafuatayo ni mambo machache unayoweza kujaribu:
  * Kunywa maji zaidi. 
  * Jaribu kupumzika, kwani msongo unaweza kufanya maumivu ya kichwa kuwa mabaya zaidi. 
  * Tumia dawa za kutuliza maumivu, kama vile paracetamol, ibuprofen, au aspirini. 
  * Hakikisha unapata usingizi wa kutosha.


Ikiwa unatumia dawa za kutuliza maumivu mara kwa mara ili kupunguza maumivu ya kichwa, unaweza kupata maumivu ya kichwa yanayojirudia mara baada ya dawa kuisha. Ikiwa unahisi maumivu ya kichwa kila mara, nenda kamuone daktari. 
## Wakati wa kumuona daktari
Kufahamu eneo la maumivu ya kichwa siyo njia inayofaa kwa 100% ya kutambua kinachosababisha maumivu husika. Ikiwa unakabiliwa na maumivu ya kichwa mara kwa mara, dawa za kutuliza maumivu hazisaidii, au maumivu yanaathiri kwa kiasi kikubwa maisha yako, ni wakati wa kwenda kumuona daktari. 
Ikiwa unakabiliwa na dalili zifuatazo pamoja na maumivu makali ya kichwa, unapaswa kutafuta msaada wa matibabu ya dharura: 
  * Maumivu ya taya wakati wa kula
  * Kuona ukungu au vitu viwili-viwili
  * Maumivu ya ngozi ya kichwa 
  * Mikono au miguu kuwa dhaifu au kufa ganzi
  * Kichefuchefu au kutapika
  * Kutostahimili mwanga mkali


Unaweza kuanza kufanya maamuzi sahihi kuhusu afya yako sasa kwa kupakua app ya Ada.

# Conjuntivite viral
Escrito pelo nosso [Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/pt/team/medical/)
Atualizado em 7 de abril de 2022 às 12:49 GMT+2
## Nesta página
  * [Visão geral](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#visao-geral)
  * [Riscos](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#riscos)
  * [Sintomas](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamento](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#tratamento)
  * [Prevenção](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#prevencao)
  * [Prognóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#prognostico)
  * [Outros nomes](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/#outros-nomes)


* * *
Compartilhe esse artigo:
## Visão geral
Conjuntivite viral é uma infecção, provocada por um vírus, da camada fina mais externa do olho que cobre o globo ocular e o interior das pálpebras (a conjuntiva). Esta condição pode afetar pessoas de todas as idades, embora tende a afetar crianças um pouco mais frequentemente do que os adultos. Os sintomas incluem olhos vermelhos com coceira, corrimento nasal e tosse. Esta condição é contagiosa, por isso é importante tomar medidas simples para evitar infectar outras pessoas, tais como ficar em casa quando estiver doente e lavar as mãos regularmente. A conjuntivite viral geralmente melhora sem tratamento específico, após 5 a 7 dias.
Você se preocupa que você ou um familiar seu possam ter essa condição? Comece sua [o aplicativo](https://ada.com/pt/app/) primeiro.
## Riscos
Conjuntivite viral ocorre quando um vírus causa inchaço e vermelhidão na camada mais externa do olho (conjuntiva). Existem vários tipos de vírus que podem causar essa condição. Alguns são comuns e causam sintomas leves, como os vírus de gripes e resfriados, enquanto outros podem causar sintomas mais graves, tais como o vírus zoster (o virus da varicela e do herpes zoster). A conjuntivite viral é geralmente contagiosa e pode ser transmitida por gotículas excretadas quando se espirra, tosse ou com contato íntimo com a pessoa doente. A conjuntivite viral pode afetar qualquer pessoa, independentemente da idade ou sexo. Crianças e pessoas com sistema imunológico debilitado podem ser especialmente vulneráveis ​​à conjuntivite viral.
## Sintomas
Os sintomas típicos de conjuntivite viral são os olhos vermelhos, lacrimejantes e coçando. Às vezes, apenas um olho é afetado antes que os sintomas eventualmente, se desenvolvam também no segundo olho. Algumas pessoas acham que seus olhos são especialmente sensíveis à luz. Pessoas com conjuntivite viral também muitas vezes têm sintomas de resfriado ou gripe, e podem ter um corrimento nasal, dor de garganta e tosse. A visão é normal durante um episódio de conjuntivite viral.
## Diagnóstico
O diagnóstico é feito com base nos sintomas e aparência dos olhos. Para diagnosticar, pode ser necessário identificar o vírus específico que causa a infecção, e uma amostra da secreção do olho pode ser pesquisada para identifica-lo.
## Tratamento
Geralmente não é necessário tratamento específico para a conjuntivite viral, pois os sintomas desaparecem ao fim de um par de semanas. Usar colírios lubrificantes e colocar compressas frias sobre os olhos pode ajudar a aliviar os sintomas. Se houver uma infecção grave, ou se a pessoa afetada tem um sistema imunológico enfraquecido, poderá ser necessário o uso de medicação antiviral.
## Prevenção
Esta condição é contagiosa, portanto, tomar medidas simples para evitar infectar outras pessoas, tais como ficar em casa quando estiver doente e lavar as mãos regularmente, pode ajudar a prevenir a transmissão do vírus para outras pessoas.
## Prognóstico
A conjuntivite viral geralmente começa a melhorar depois de 5 a 7 dias, e pode durar por 2-4 semanas. Ela geralmente melhora sem qualquer tratamento específico. Pessoas com um sistema imunológico enfraquecido devem consultar um médico para diagnóstico e aconselhamento para o tratamento da conjuntivite viral.
## Outros nomes
  * olho vermelho por infecção ocular viral

# Perimenopause
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on September 20, 2024 at 3:00 PM GMT+3
## On this page
  * [Overview](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#overview)
  * [What is perimenopause](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#what-is-perimenopause)
  * [Stages of perimenopause](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#stages-of-perimenopause)
  * [Symptoms of perimenopause](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#symptoms-of-perimenopause)
  * [Causes of perimenopause](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#causes-of-perimenopause)
  * [How long does perimenopause last? ](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#how-long-does-perimenopause-last)
  * [How can perimenopause be diagnosed?](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#how-can-perimenopause-be-diagnosed)
  * [What treatments exist for perimenopause symptoms?](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#what-treatments-exist-for-perimenopause-symptoms)
  * [Wrapping up](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#wrapping-up)
  * [Perimenopause FAQs](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#perimenopause-faqs)


* * *
Share this article:
## Overview
  * Perimenopause is the phase before actual menopause, in which you can notice irregularities in your menstrual cycle, mood changes, and other physical symptoms.
  * The average age of perimenopause is 40 to 44, but it can also occur earlier or later in some women. 
  * Perimenopause treatment is mainly focused on symptom relief.


Think you might be experiencing perimenopause
Perimenopause is a stage in which women experience a transition from their reproductive age towards menopause
## What is perimenopause
Perimenopause is the period before menopause[1](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Feeling unwell? Get a symptom assessment with the 
## Stages of perimenopause
Perimenopause is the stage before menopause. Perimenopause itself can also be divided into different substages, each of which has its characteristics: [2](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
  * Very early perimenopause
  * Early perimenopause
  * Late perimenopause


After these stages, you’ll reach the end of your perimenopause. Some signs your perimenopause is ending can be that you haven’t had your period for quite some time and that you notice symptoms of perimenopause. Your symptoms should decrease once a year has passed since you’ve last had your period.
## Symptoms of perimenopause
The symptoms of perimenopause are [caused by the hormonal changes](https://ada.com/hormones/) in your body and can be noticed both physically and mentally. Some common signs of perimenopause [3](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
  * [Hot flushes: a feeling of sudden heat in the face, neck or chest](https://ada.com/conditions/vasomotor-symptoms-hot-flashes/)
  * Night sweats
  * Palpitations
  * Changes in menstruation 
  * Vaginal dryness
  * Painful breasts 
  * Painful intercourse
  * Reduced sex drive
  * [Painful joints and muscles](https://ada.com/conditions/muscle-joint-pain/)
  * Changes to your body composition
  * Having dry and itchy skin
  * Recurrent [urinary tract infections](https://ada.com/conditions/urinary-tract-infection/)
  * [Incontinence](https://ada.com/conditions/urinary-incontinence/)
  * Difficulty sleeping
  * [Headaches](https://ada.com/conditions/headache/)
  * Changes in mood
  * Memory problems
  * [Depression](https://ada.com/signs-of-depression/)
  * Anxiety


Perimenopause symptoms can vary in nature and intensity
Think you might be experiencing perimenopause
## Causes of perimenopause
Perimenopause is a natural process that happens when women grow older, as the ovaries start to lose their function and stop releasing eggs that can be fertilized[5](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
## How long does perimenopause last? 
The duration of perimenopause can vary from woman to woman. Perimenopause starts once the menstrual cycle of a woman becomes irregular and ends 1 year after the last menstruation. For most women, the average duration of perimenopause is between 3 to 4 years[1](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
## How can perimenopause be diagnosed?
The diagnosis of perimenopause can be made based on your age and the symptoms you’re experiencing[levels of estradiol](https://ada.com/hormones/estradiol/), [follicle-stimulating hormone](https://ada.com/hormones/follicle-stimulating-hormone/), and [luteinizing hormone](https://ada.com/hormones/luteinizing-hormone/), which typically have different values during menopause. [6](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
## What treatments exist for perimenopause symptoms?
Perimenopause treatment is focused on symptom relief and the prevention of complications.
Systemic hormonal treatment[osteoporosis](https://ada.com/conditions/osteoporosis/). This therapy can be administered in various forms, such as tablets, sprays, gels, patches, or vaginal rings. Which hormones you need depends on your situation. Hormonal treatment should only be given for a limited amount of time, so it’s essential to follow the instructions of your healthcare provider. [5](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
Local estrogen therapy[5](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
Non-hormonal treatment [5](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * Paroxetine
  * Escitalopram
  * Gabapentin
  * Neurokinin B  



During perimenopause, vitamin supplements may help relieve your symptoms. Studies show that the best perimenopause supplements[5](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * [Vitamin E](https://ada.com/micronutrients/vitamin-e/)
  * Omega-3
  * Milk thistle


Perimenopause self-care [5](https://ada.com/conditions/perimenopause/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * Maintaining a healthy weight
  * Cognitive behavioral therapy
  * Wearing breathable clothing 
  * Doing exercise


## Wrapping up
Perimenopause is the stage that marks the shift between the reproductive years of a woman and menopause. During this stage, you can experience various symptoms such as anxiety, weight gain, and hot flashes. To relieve these symptoms, you can ask your healthcare provider for the appropriate treatment option.
## Find out more about your symptoms
## Perimenopause FAQs
Q: When does perimenopause start?   
A: Perimenopause usually starts at the age of 40 to 44, although it can also start earlier or later in life. 
Q: Can you get pregnant during perimenopause?   
A: Although it’s less common, and the chances of getting pregnant are lower than in your reproductive years, it’s still possible to get pregnant during perimenopause. 
Q: What does a hot flash feel like during perimenopause?   
A: A hot flash during perimenopause can feel like a sudden feeling of warmth in the face, neck, or chest area. You may feel sweaty, and your skin can redden as well.
Q: How do you know if you are in perimenopause?   
A: If you're in perimenopause, then your menstrual cycle will start being irregular. After that, you can also start noticing common symptoms of perimenopause, such as anxiety, hot flashes, and weight gain.

# Atopisches Ekzem bei Kindern (Dermatitis)
Verfasst von [Adas medizinischem Fachpersonal](https://ada.com/de/team/medical/)
Aktualisiert am 15. Februar 2022 um 10:01 OEZ
## Auf dieser Seite
  * [Was ist ein atopisches Ekzem (Dermatitis) bei Kindern?](https://ada.com/de/conditions/infantile-atopic-dermatitis/#was-ist-ein-atopisches-ekzem-dermatitis-bei-kindern)
  * [Risiken](https://ada.com/de/conditions/infantile-atopic-dermatitis/#risiken)
  * [Symptome](https://ada.com/de/conditions/infantile-atopic-dermatitis/#symptome)
  * [Diagnose](https://ada.com/de/conditions/infantile-atopic-dermatitis/#diagnose)
  * [Behandlung](https://ada.com/de/conditions/infantile-atopic-dermatitis/#behandlung)
  * [Prognose](https://ada.com/de/conditions/infantile-atopic-dermatitis/#prognose)

Artikel teilen:
## Was ist ein atopisches Ekzem (Dermatitis) bei Kindern?
Eine atopische Ekzem bei Kindern, häufig auch als atopische Dermatitis bezeichnet, ist eine sehr häufige Hauterkrankung bei Kindern. Menschen mit dieser Erkrankung leiden aufgrund von Allergien oder einer auf bestimmte Substanzen empfindlich reagierenden Haut unter Dermatitis (Entzündung der Haut).
Sie neigt dazu, bei Kindern unter fünf Jahren aufzutreten. Die typischen Symptome sind ein roter, juckender Ausschlag und schuppige, trockene Haut. Diese Symptome können als Reaktion auf bestimmte Auslöser aufflammen (sich verschlimmern).
Zur Behandlung wird der Feuchtigkeitsgehalt der Haut bewahrt und Cremes oder Medikamente verwendet, um die Haut zu beruhigen und die Entzündung zu behandeln. Bei vielen Kindern mit atopischen Ekzemen bessern sich die Beschwerden mit der Zeit und sie zeigen als Jugendliche möglicherweise keine Symptome mehr auf.
Hat Dein Kind Beschwerden oder Symptome, die auf diese Erkrankung hinweisen könnten? Starte jetzt eine kostenlose Symptomanalyse mit der 
## Risiken für ein atopischen Ekzem bei Kindern
Atopische Dermatitis bei Kindern ist eine sehr häufige Erkrankung. Ein atopisches Ekzem tritt normalerweise vor dem sechsten Lebensjahr auf und tritt oft zum ersten Mal vor dem ersten Geburtstag auf.
Bei Kindern mit Allergien (einschließlich Heuschnupfen und [allergischem Asthma](https://ada.com/de/conditions/childhood-asthma/)) oder Kinder, deren Eltern an diesen Erkrankungen leiden, besteht eine höhere Wahrscheinlichkeit, atopische Ekzeme zu bekommen.
Faktoren, die zu atopischen Ekzemen führen, sind unter anderem:
  * Trockenheit,
  * Hitze und Schwitzen,
  * irritierende Substanzen (wie zum Beispiel bestimmte Kleidung oder Chemikalien),
  * emotionaler oder körperlicher Stress,
  * Hautinfektionen und
  * Allergene, häufig Nahrungsmittel.


## Was sind atopische Ekzem-Symptome?
Die typischen Symptome von Ekzemen sind ein roter, juckender Ausschlag und schuppige, trockene Haut.
Er befällt häufig das Gesicht, die Kopfhaut, die Ellbogen und die Knie. Bei Kindern, die lange Zeit unter Ekzemen leiden, können sich durch das Kratzen oder Reiben verdickte Haut oder Narben bilden. Wenn sich der Ausschlag entzündet, kann im Bereich der Ekzeme ein dicker, gelber Schleim sowie Rötungen und Krusten entstehen.
## Wie sieht die Diagnose bei atopischen Ekzemen aus?
Eine Diagnose basiert gewöhnlich auf den Symptomen und der äußerlichen Erscheinung des Ausschlags. Ein Tagebuch über die Symptome und Tests auf bestimmte Allergien können bei der Identifizierung der Auslöser des Ekzems helfen.
## Wie werden atopische Ekzeme behandelt?
Indem die Haut feucht gehalten wird,
Seifen oder Badlösungen, die Feuchtigkeitsmittel oder Öle enthalten, können die Haut beruhigen
## Was ist die Prognose bei atopischen Ekzemen?
Bei den meisten Kindern, die an atopischer Dermatitis leiden, bessert sich die Erkrankung mit zunehmendem Alter und verschwindet möglicherweise im Jugendalter. Sie können immer zu empfindlicher und trockener Haut neigen. Manche Kinder können bis ins Erwachsenenalter hinein weiterhin an Ekzemen leiden.
## Wie kann man atopischen Ekzemen vorbeugen?
Durch die Identifizierung und Meidung von Auslösern,

# Acute Laryngitis
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on August 5, 2025 at 5:06 PM GMT+3
## On this page
  * [What is acute laryngitis?](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#what-is-acute-laryngitis)
  * [Symptoms](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#symptoms)
  * [Causes](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#causes)
  * [Risks](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#risks)
  * [Diagnosis](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#diagnosis)
  * [Treatment](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#treatment)
  * [Prevention](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#prevention)
  * [Other names for acute laryngitis](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#other-names-for-acute-laryngitis)
  * [FAQ](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#faq)


* * *
Share this article:
## What is acute laryngitis?
Acute laryngitis is a short-term inflammatory condition affecting the larynx, or voice box, typically lasting less than 3 weeks. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Laryngitis which lasts longer than three weeks is called chronic laryngitis; see this resource for more information.
Laryngitis can affect people of every age and gender. The main symptoms of laryngitis are a hoarse voice, also known as dysphonia, and sore throat, due to inflammation in the laryngeal area.
Acute laryngitis may have infectious or non-infectious causes, including overuse of the voice which puts a strain on the vocal cords, or gastrointestinal reflux disease (GERD); laryngitis caused by GERD is called reflux laryngitis.
Treatment for laryngitis may include resting the voice, simple pain relief, and home remedies such as drinking warm liquids to soothe the throat. If laryngeal discomfort and other symptoms are still present after three weeks, antibiotics may be prescribed, if the cause is diagnosed to be a bacterial infection. An antifungal medication may be prescribed if the cause is a fungal infection.
Most people recover from acute laryngitis within three weeks and do not go on to develop chronic laryngitis.
Think you might be experiencing acute laryngitis
## Symptoms
Typical symptoms of laryngitis include:
  * Dysphonia (hoarseness of the voice)
  * Fever (during the first few days of infection)
  * Sore throat
  * A need to clear the throat frequently
  * A cough


Symptoms usually appear suddenly and worsen after around three days. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") After around three weeks, with appropriate treatment including drinking plenty of water and resting the larynx, symptoms such as a cough and hoarse voice usually relieve.
Even though acute laryngitis usually relives without the need for medical attention, it is important for an affected person to see a doctor promptly if they:
  * Experience swallowing problems (dysphagia)
  * Cough up blood
  * Have trouble breathing
  * Have a persistent fever, with a temperature of higher than 103 F (39.4 C)
  * Have respiratory problems (breathing difficulties)


These symptoms may indicate epiglottitisEpiglottitis can be life-threatening for both children and adults.[2](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
In children, the symptoms of laryngitis are the same as those in adults. When children under five are affected, the condition is called croup.[3](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
## Causes
There are both infectious and non-infectious causes of acute laryngitis. The most common causes are [flu](https://ada.com/conditions/influenza-infection/) or [cold due to a virus](https://ada.com/conditions/common-cold/). Non-infectious causes include overuse of the voice, gastric reflux (which can irritate the lining of the throat), or an injury to the voice box region.
The hoarseness of the voice
Find here more information about [laryngitis from Covid](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-laryngitis/). 
## Risks
While hoarseness of voice persists, it is advisable to avoid overusing one’s voice (shouting or speaking for prolonged periods), because this can result in permanent damage to the vocal cords.
It is important to treat the condition before it becomes chronic (long-lasting), because having an inflamed larynx for a prolonged period of time can result in the development of tears and/or growths in the laryngeal tissue, as well as vocal cord strain. See this resource on [chronic laryngitis](https://ada.com/conditions/chronic-laryngitis/) for more information.
## Diagnosis
The diagnosis is usually made by examination of the throat. Doctors will focus on diagnosing the cause of the laryngitis, because this will determine the appropriate treatment, if any is needed. If laryngitis is due to a known underlying condition such as gastrointestinal reflux disease (GERD), the treatment and management plan for this may be adjusted, to prevent further laryngeal problems.
Doctors may perform a laryngoscopy[4](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-laryngitis/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") This may be done indirectly or directly. An indirect laryngoscopy involves the doctor shining a light into the throat to examine the larynx, using a handheld mirror. A direct laryngoscopy involves the doctor inserting a small tube with a camera attached to it into the throat through the mouth to examine the larynx in detail.
## Treatment
Treatment depends on the source of the problem but mainly involves resting the larynx by not overusing the voice while hoarseness is present. Drinking warm liquids and using medicated throat lozenges may be useful to soothe the throat.
Home remedies such as adding ginger or turmeric to warm drinks can help fight infections. Simple pain medications (ibuprofen or paracetamol) can help with the pain. If the condition is caused by bacteria, the treatment may involve antibiotics.
## Prevention
Prevention can be achieved by moderate use of the voice, and taking care to avoid catching or spreading viruses. Giving up smoking may also help to avoid laryngitis.
## Other names for acute laryngitis
  * Acute inflammation of the larynx


## Find out more about your symptoms
## Acute laryngitis FAQs
Q: Is acute laryngitis contagious?  
A:Most cases of laryngitis result from viruses, which themselves are not particularly contagious.
Q: What happens when laryngitis becomes chronic?  
A:[sinusitis](https://ada.com/conditions/viral-sinusitis/). The symptoms of acute (short-lasting) laryngitis are the same as those of chronic (long-lasting) laryngitis, including a sore throat, hoarseness of the voice and having a cough. It is important to seek treatment if symptoms persist, because vocal cord strain and growths on the vocal cords can develop as a result of continual inflammation of the larynx.

# Vértigo postural paroxístico benigno
Escrito por nuestro [Equipo de Profesionales Médicos](https://ada.com/es/team/medical/)
Actualizado el 15 de febrero de 2022, 10:00 EET
## En esta página
  * [Resumen](https://ada.com/es/conditions/benign-paroxysmal-positional-vertigo/#resumen)
  * [Riesgos](https://ada.com/es/conditions/benign-paroxysmal-positional-vertigo/#riesgos)
  * [Síntomas](https://ada.com/es/conditions/benign-paroxysmal-positional-vertigo/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/es/conditions/benign-paroxysmal-positional-vertigo/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamiento](https://ada.com/es/conditions/benign-paroxysmal-positional-vertigo/#tratamiento)
  * [Prevención](https://ada.com/es/conditions/benign-paroxysmal-positional-vertigo/#prevencion)
  * [Pronóstico](https://ada.com/es/conditions/benign-paroxysmal-positional-vertigo/#pronostico)


* * *
Comparte este artículo:
## Resumen
El vértigo postural paroxístico benigno (VPPB) es un problema común del oído interno que causa episodios breves de mareo (vértigo) relacionados con ciertos movimientos de la cabeza. Estos episodios son provocados por partículas (cristales) que irritan los canales semicirculares (la parte del oído interno que regula el equilibrio). Además del mareo, las personas que tienen vértigo postural paroxístico benigno (VPPB) sienten náuseas y es posible que vomiten durante estos ataques. El VPPB tiende a mejorar con el paso de semanas o meses, pero puede reaparecer.
## Riesgos
El vértigo postural paroxístico benigno puede aparecer a cualquier edad, sin embargo es más común que resulten afectados los adultos mayores en comparación con los niños y los adultos jóvenes. La causa del VPPB no se comprende bien, pero se cree que se debe a un problema del oído interno causado por partículas (cristales) que irritan los conductos semicirculares (la parte del oído interno que regula el equilibrio). En casos extraños, una lesión en la cabeza puede llevar a VPPB.
## Síntomas
Los ataques de mareos breves y recurrentes son el síntoma principal del vértigo postural paroxístico benigno. El mareo asociado con el vértigo suele sentirse como si todo girara a su alrededor, en lugar de una sensación de ligero aturdimiento. El mareo puede estar acompañado de náuseas, vómitos y pérdida del equilibrio. Los ataques suelen ocurrir después de cambiar la posición de la cabeza, como al girar la cabeza súbitamente o cambiar de una posición de acostado a sentado.
## Diagnóstico
El diagnóstico se realiza en una consulta médica valiéndose de un examen físico. El diagnóstico puede confirmarse con análisis específicos.
## Tratamiento
Esta forma de mareo se puede tratar con ciertas maniobras de recolocación (maniobras de Epley o ejercicios de Brandt-Daroff). Es posible que los síntomas empeoren mientras se realizan estas series de ejercicios controlados. Luego de recibir las instrucciones sobre cómo realizarlos, algunos de estos ejercicios se pueden hacer en casa. Normalmente el vértigo postural paroxístico benigno se puede tratar bien de esta manera. No se usan medicamentos, aunque podrían ayudar a manejar las náuseas asociadas con el mareo. En casos graves y persistentes, la cirugía puede ser una opción de tratamiento.
## Prevención
Las personas que tienen vértigo postural paroxístico benigno probablemente deban evitar ciertas actividades o movimientos que provocan episodios de mareo, ya que este puede tornar inseguras esas actividades.
## Pronóstico
El vértigo postural paroxístico benigno es inofensivo pero desagradable y tiende a desaparecer en cuestión de semanas o meses, sin embargo los síntomas pueden volver a presentarse en el futuro.

# Subluxação e luxação do quadril
Escrito pelo nosso [Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/pt/team/medical/)
Atualizado em 15 de fevereiro de 2022 às 10:00 GMT+2
## Nesta página
  * [Visão geral](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#visao-geral)
  * [Riscos](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#riscos)
  * [Sintomas](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamento](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#tratamento)
  * [Prevenção](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#prevencao)
  * [Prognóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#prognostico)
  * [Outros nomes](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/subluxation-and-dislocation-of-the-hip/#outros-nomes)


* * *
Compartilhe esse artigo:
## Visão geral
A luxação do quadril é uma situação em que a cabeça do osso da coxa (fêmur) saiu de seu encaixe, em uma cavidade na articulação do quadril (acetábulo) e assim as duas partes da articulação ficam separadas. O quadril lesionado causa muita dor e a pessoa talvez não aguente o próprio peso sobre a perna. A luxação de quadril deve ser examinada com urgência por um médico, e os ossos reposicionados o mais rápido possível. Uma vez que as partes da articulação sejam reposicionadas, a maioria das pessoas se recupera bem.
Você se preocupa que você ou um familiar seu possam ter essa condição? Comece sua [o aplicativo](https://ada.com/pt/app/) primeiro.
## Riscos
A luxação do quadril ocorre quando o osso da coxa sai de seu encaixe no quadril. As luxações do quadril são mais comuns nos idosos. Pessoas que fizeram uma substituição de quadril também têm um risco maior de desenvolver luxação do quadril, e essa é uma das causas mais comuns. Outras causas são uma lesão na pélvis ou na perna, especialmente lesões que envolvem alto impacto, como em um acidente de carro. A lesão pode ocorrer durante alguns esportes de alto impacto, como o esqui de descida livre, ginástica, rugby e futebol americano. Crianças nascidas com displasia de quadril (má formação do quadril de nascimento) têm também maior risco de desenvolver esta condição.
## Sintomas
Os sintomas mais comuns de uma luxação de quadril são dor no quadril e dificuldade de apoiar o peso na perna afetada. O quadril não pode ser movido normalmente, e a perna do lado afetado pode parecer mais curta e voltada para dentro, ou para fora. Algumas pessoas sentem dormência e fraqueza no lado da luxação do quadril.
## Diagnóstico
O diagnóstico é geralmente feito com base num exame físico e num raio-X do quadril. Caso haja algum osso fraturado, pode-se pedir uma TC (tomografia computadorizada), para analisar de forma completa os danos na articulação e assim planejar o tratamento.
## Tratamento
O tratamento tem como objetivo aliviar a dor e reposicionar o osso da coxa em seu encaixe. Isso precisa de ser feito o mais cedo possível para reduzir as chances de complicações. Se não houver fatores complicadores, tais como ossos fraturados, o reposicionamento pode ser feito empurrando o osso de volta ao seu lugar. Isto deve ser feito por um médico, e muitas vezes requer o medicação contra a dor e sedação. Quando há ossos quebrados o reposicionamento é cirúrgico.
## Prevenção
Crianças que têm displasia de quadril devem ser tratadas para esta condição. Evitar esportes de alto impacto pode ajudar a prevenir alguns casos de luxação do quadril.
## Prognóstico
A maioria das pessoas se recupera bem após o tratamento para uma luxação do quadril sem complicações. A articulação do quadril precisa ser reposicionada o mais rápido possível, pois caso contrário a irrigação de sangue para o osso da coxa pode ser afetada e o osso pode morrer. A recuperação pode ficar complicada quando a luxação do quadril também é acompanhada por fraturas no osso da coxa ou da pélvis. Algumas pessoas, como os idosos, podem sofrer luxações recorrentes do quadril .
## Outros nomes
  * gangstörung kindnto completo ou parcial do quadril

# Tietze Syndrome
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on March 10, 2022 at 11:26 AM GMT+2
## On this page
  * [What is Tietze syndrome?](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#what-is-tietze-syndrome)
  * [Causes](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#causes)
  * [Symptoms](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#symptoms)
  * [Diagnosis](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#diagnosis)
    * [Differential Diagnosis](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#differential-diagnosis)
  * [Treatment](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#treatment)
  * [Prognosis](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#prognosis)


* * *
Share this article:
This article contains self-care information for the selected condition. If you have questions or need more comprehensive treatment advice, please consult a medical professional.
## What is Tietze syndrome?
Tietze syndrome is a relatively rare condition that causes localized pain and swelling of the cartilage of one or more of the upper ribs (upper front of the chest). [1](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
The symptoms are usually mild. However, pain may get worse during physical activity or when taking a deep breath, coughing, or sneezing.
Teenagers and young adults under the age of 40 are the most commonly affected.
Diagnosis is usually based on a physical examination. Other medical imaging tests may be needed to rule out other causes of pain and swelling.
Treatment normally involves rest and mild painkillers. In more severe cases, an injection of local anesthetic or steroids may be needed. The symptoms usually go away after 1 to 2 weeks, and most people recover completely without further complications.
If you are worried that you or someone you know may have this condition, use the
## What causes Tietze syndrome?
The cause of Tietze syndrome is not well understood. One of the possible reasons is small injuries, known as microtraumas, causing damage or swelling to the ribs. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [2](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3").
These minor injuries can come from:
  * Chronic trauma: frequent coughing, sneezing, or vomiting
  * Acute trauma: Strenuous activities during sports, exercise, or accidents.


The condition most commonly affects teenagers and young adults under 40 years of age. However, it can affect older and younger people as well [3](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4").
## Symptoms of Tietze syndrome
Symptoms of Tietze syndrome may include:
  * Pain
  * Tenderness
  * Swelling
  * Redness or warmth


These symptoms most commonly affect the second or third upper ribs. It's often possible with Tietze Syndrome to feel a lump on the chest. The pain may further extend to the neck, shoulders, or upper arms. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
## Diagnosis
To establish the diagnosis of Tietze syndrome, other conditions that cause pain and swelling at the upper front chest may need to be ruled out first. [5](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [3](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") Doctors will have to take the person’s medical history and conduct a physical examination to identify the characteristics of the symptoms first.
Furthermore, several tests such as electrocardiogram, medical imaging tests (e.g., X-ray, CT or MRI scans) or biopsies may be necessary to assess the extent of the symptoms and to exclude other causes. [6](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6") Given that soft tissue swelling (a lump) is one of the hallmarks of Tietze syndrome, an ultrasound can be one of the most effective tools to assist in the diagnosis. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
### Differential Diagnosis
The most common differential diagnosis of Tietze Syndrome is [costochondritis](https://ada.com/conditions/costochondritis/) as they both present with front upper chest wall pain and discomfort. The pain in Tietze syndrome is usually localized within a smaller area and accompanied by swelling, whereas costochondritis usually presents as pain in multiple ribs without swelling around the damaged joints. [3](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
## Tietze Syndrome Treatment
The treatment of Tietze Syndrome aims to alleviate the pain and usually depends on the severity of discomfort. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
  * Mild
  * Moderate
  * Severe


## Prognosis
Generally speaking, the symptoms of Tietze syndrome go away after 1 or 2 weeks. Most people recover well without further complications. The long-term outlook is usually good without any complications. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/tietze-syndrome/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")

# Infecção do tracto urinário pediátrica
Escrito pelo nosso [Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/pt/team/medical/)
Atualizado em 15 de fevereiro de 2022 às 10:01 GMT+2
## Nesta página
  * [Visão geral](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/pediatric-urinary-tract-infection/#visao-geral)
  * [Riscos](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/pediatric-urinary-tract-infection/#riscos)
  * [Sintomas](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/pediatric-urinary-tract-infection/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/pediatric-urinary-tract-infection/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamento](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/pediatric-urinary-tract-infection/#tratamento)
  * [Prevenção](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/pediatric-urinary-tract-infection/#prevencao)
  * [Prognóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/pediatric-urinary-tract-infection/#prognostico)


* * *
Compartilhe esse artigo:
## Visão geral
Infecção do tracto urinário é uma condição comum em crianças, causada por bactérias que infectam qualquer parte do sistema urinário. O sistema urinário inclui a uretra (o tubo que começa na bexiga até à pele), a bexiga, os ureteres (os tubos entre os rins e a bexiga) e os rins. A infecção não é transmissível. Em geral essa condição se desenvolve quando bactérias do intestino ou da região genital ascendem pela uretra para a bexiga ou o rim. Os sintomas incluem febre, dor na região inferior da barriga, micção frequente em pequenas porções e um cheiro estranho na urina. A maioria das crianças se recupera rapidamente com o tratamento antibiótico.
## Riscos
As crianças pequenas são mais propensos do que as crianças mais velhas a contrair esta condição. Meninos não circuncisados podem ser mais propensos a contrair esta condição do que os meninos circuncisados. Crianças com um trato urinário que não se formou adequadamente antes do nascimento são mais propensos a ter infecções, assim como as crianças com outras condições médicas. Isto inclui crianças com um sistema imunitário enfraquecido e as crianças que necessitam de um cateter urinário.
## Sintomas
As crianças pequenas podem ter apenas os sintomas gerais de uma infecção. Estes são entre outros irritabilidade, perda de apetite, vômitos e febre. Sinais inespecíficos são comuns em crianças. As crianças mais velhas podem ter urina com cheiro forte, sangue na urina, dor na barriga e dor ao urinar. Dor nas costas ou nos lados pode ser um sinal de que a inflamação se espalhou para os rins ([pielonefrite](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/acute-pyelonephritis/)).
## Diagnóstico
O diagnóstico é baseado nos sintomas e no exame físico e é confirmada pela análise da urina, para a presença de sangue e pus. Talvez seja necessário enviar a urina para um laboratório para identificar as bactérias específicas que causam a infecção. Se a criança sofre infecções urinárias repetidas, também pode ser necessário fazer uma ultrassonografia da bexiga e dos rins em crianças muito pequenas se elas têm repetidas infecções.
## Tratamento
As infecções das vias urinárias são tratadas com antibióticos. Crianças muito doentes ou que têm outras condições médicas podem necessitar de tratamento no hospital com administração de fluidos e antibióticos por via intravenosa. Ajuda muito estar bem hidratado, a fim de livrar a bexiga de bactérias.
## Prevenção
Manter a área do meato urinário (onde a urina sai do corpo) limpo ajuda a evitar infecções do tracto urinário. Exemplos de uma boa higiene são trocar fraldas regularmente e limpar a região do meato da frente para trás com lenços umedecidos ou papel higiênico.
## Prognóstico
O tratamento com antibiótico adequado, a cistite (infecção da bexiga) geralmente melhora em alguns dias, sem quaisquer complicações. A pielonefrite (infecção dos rins) geralmente leva mais tempo para sarar, e pode causar cicatrização dos rins. As crianças com outras condições médicas ou que têm um trato urinário que não se formou adequadamente antes do nascimento são mais propensas a ter infecções recorrentes ou difíceis de tratar.

# How do I access the Condition and Medical Libraries?
Ada's Condition and Medical Libraries are a collection of information about medical conditions and illnesses, including all those in Ada's database and those related to your recent assessments. You can find them in the Ada app and the Ada website.
To access the Condition Library:
  1. Open the Ada app.
  2. Click on 🔍 Conditions located at the bottom right corner of the screen. This will take you to a list of health conditions organized into categories. 
  3. Scroll through these categories to find a condition. Alternatively, search for a specific condition in the search bar.


Additionally, the Medical Library, available on Ada's website, provides tips for maintaining good health and information about various medical conditions. Access the Medical Library [here](https://ada.com/conditions/).

# Dermatitis atópica
Escrito por nuestro [Equipo de Profesionales Médicos](https://ada.com/es/team/medical/)
Actualizado el 15 de febrero de 2022, 10:00 EET
## En esta página
  * [Resumen](https://ada.com/es/conditions/atopic-dermatitis/#resumen)
  * [Riesgos](https://ada.com/es/conditions/atopic-dermatitis/#riesgos)
  * [Síntomas](https://ada.com/es/conditions/atopic-dermatitis/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/es/conditions/atopic-dermatitis/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamiento](https://ada.com/es/conditions/atopic-dermatitis/#tratamiento)
  * [Prevención](https://ada.com/es/conditions/atopic-dermatitis/#prevencion)
  * [Pronóstico](https://ada.com/es/conditions/atopic-dermatitis/#pronostico)


* * *
Comparte este artículo:
## Resumen
La dermatitis atópica, también llamado eccema atópico, es un problema muy común de la piel, especialmente en los niños. Las personas con dermatitis (inflamación de la piel) suelen tener alergias o tener una piel sensible a ciertas sustancias. Este problema tiende a afectar a los niños antes de los 5 años de edad y puede persistir con el paso del tiempo. Los síntomas típicos son un sarpullido con picazón y piel seca y escamosa y estos síntomas tienden a empeorar en respuesta a ciertos desencadenantes. El tratamiento implica mantener la piel húmeda y usar cremas o medicamentos para calmar la piel y tratar la inflamación. Muchos niños que tienen dermatitis atópica descubren que mejora con el paso del tiempo y es posible que no tengan síntomas para cuando lleguen a la adolescencia. Algunas personas tienen eccema atópico que continúa hasta la adultez.
## Riesgos
La dermatitis atópica es un problema común. Se diagnostica principalmente a niños menores de 5 años y es muy raro que ocurra por primera vez en la adultez. Las personas que tienen alergias (incluso alergia al polen y asma alérgica) son más propensos a presentar un eccema atópico. Los factores que desencadenan el eccema atópico pueden ser sequedad, calor y transpiración, sustancias irritantes (como ciertas ropas o productos químicos), estrés físico o emocional, infecciones de la piel y alérgenos, frecuentemente alimentos.
## Síntomas
Los síntomas típicos del eccema son un sarpullido rojo que pica y piel seca y escamosa. Este sarpullido podría supurar y la piel puede quedar en carne viva si se rasca persistentemente. Suele afectar la cara, el cuero cabelludo, los codos y las rodillas y si el eccema persiste mucho tiempo, la piel puede engrosarse o pueden aparecer cicatrices por rascarse o frotarse. Si el sarpullido se infecta, podría supurar un líquido espeso y amarillo, y la zona puede enrojecerse y formar costra.
## Diagnóstico
El diagnóstico suele basarse en los síntomas y en el aspecto del sarpullido. Llevar un diario de los síntomas y realizar una prueba para identificar alérgenos específicos puede ser útil para identificar los desencadenantes del eccema.
## Tratamiento
Mantener la piel humectada ayuda a aliviar los síntomas del eccema atópico. Algunas personas usan paños húmedos o vendas en las zonas de piel seca e irritada. Usar jabones o productos de baño que contengan sustancias humectantes o aceites puede ayudar a aliviar la piel y protegerla de las sustancias irritantes. Las cremas con medicamentos esteroides suelen usarse para tratar los ataques de eccema y los comprimidos antihistamínicos también pueden ser útiles para reducir la picazón.
## Prevención
Identificar y evitar los desencadenantes que empeoran los síntomas puede ayudar a prevenir episodios de dermatitis atópica.
## Pronóstico
La mayoría de las personas aprenden a controlar las reacciones y evitar los desencadenantes de su dermatitis atópica, logrando de esta manera tolerar los síntomas. Los niños que tienen dermatitis atópica notarán que mejora a medida que crecen y puede que haya desaparecido para cuando lleguen a la adolescencia. Sin embargo, es posible que tengan una tendencia a tener la piel sensible y seca y algunas personas puedan continuar con eccema en la vida adulta.
