# Mpox: Was wir darüber wissen
[Harry](https://ada.com/de/editorial/writers/harry-oconnor/)
Aktualisiert am 2. September 2025 um 13:00 OESZ
Sicher hast Du schon gehört, dass sich das Mpox-Virus in Teilen der Welt ausbreitet, wo es normalerweise nicht vorkommt.
Viele Leute verfolgen die Nachrichten und haben wahrscheinlich einige Fragen zu dieser Erkrankung. Wir sind hier, um sie zu beantworten.
Falls Du auch genauer verstehen willst, was Mpox (ehemals: Affenpocken) ist, bist Du hier richtig.
## Was ist passiert?
Gesundheitsbehörden sind derzeit alarmiert, weil Wissenschaftler:innen auf Fälle von Mpox[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Das ist Grund zur Sorge, denn die Erkrankung taucht außerhalb von zentral- und westafrikanischen Ländern eher selten auf.[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Die World Health Organization (WHO) hat den derzeitigen Ausbruch von Mpox (Stand 23. Juli 2022) zu einer gesundheitlichen Notlage internationaler Tragweite erklärt.[2](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Bis dato wurden 32.000 Fälle von Mpox[2](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Die meisten Fälle im Rahmen dieses Ausbruchs traten bei Männern auf, die Sex mit anderen Männern haben.[2](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
## Was ist Mpox?
Das Mpox-Virus wurde von Wissenschaftler:innen im Jahr 1958 bei Affen entdeckt. Daher hatte es seinen ehemaligen Namen Affenpocken.[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Im Menschen wurde es zum ersten Mal im Jahr 1970 gefunden.[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Mpox stammt von der gleichen Virusfamilie wie die Pockenkrankheit ab. Allerdings ist es eine weitaus weniger schwere Erkrankung.[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Es gibt zwei Arten von Mpox: Virusgruppe I (vorher bekannt als Kongobecken-Variante) und Virusgruppe II (vorher bekannt als Westafrika-Variante).[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Eine PCR-Analyse hat ergeben, dass der aktuelle Ausbruch durch Virusgruppe II ausgelöst wurde, die zu weniger schweren Symptomen führt als Virusgruppe I.ref1
## Was sind typische Symptome bei Mpox?
Für die meisten Menschen[2](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
In der Regel löst Mpox[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
  * Kopfschmerzen
  * Rückenschmerzen
  * Muskelschmerzen
  * Geschwollene Lymphknoten


Der[3](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
Schwangere, Kinder und Menschen mit Immunschwächen haben ein erhöhtes Risiko, einen schweren Krankheitsverlauf zu entwickeln.ref1
## Wie kann man Mpox behandeln?
Die normale Pockenschutzimpfung kann in bis zu 85% der Fälle einer Infektion mit Mpox vorbeugen[3](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") Es gibt auch virenhemmende Medikamente, die nach einer Infektion mit Mpox effektiv sein können.[3](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
Für die meisten Betroffenen ist eine medikamentöse Behandlung allerdings nicht notwendig.[3](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
## Wie breitet sich Mpox aus?
Man kann sich mit Mpox[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Eine Übertragung geschieht durch Hautkontakt (auch während des Sex), Austausch von Körperflüssigkeiten und durch Tröpfchen, die beim Sprechen und Atmen ausgestoßen werden können.[1](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Auch wenn vor allen Dingen Männer, die Sex mit Männern haben vom aktuellen Ausbruch betroffen sind, gilt Mpox nicht als sexuell übertragbare Krankheit.[2](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
## Warum breitet sich Mpox gerade jetzt aus?
Die steigende Anzahl an Fällen von Mpox könnte auf den weltweiten Rückgang der Pockenschutzimpfungen in den 1980ern zurückzuführen sein.[4](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") Deswegen sind die meisten Menschen unter 45 Jahren nicht ausreichend vor Mpox und ähnlichen Viren geschützt
## Muss ich mir wegen Mpox Sorgen machen?
Gesundheitsbehörden sind derzeit in Alarmbereitschaft, weil die Situation ungewöhnlich ist. Allerdings sind sich die meisten Wissenschaftler:innen einig, dass es nicht zu einer Pandemie wie bei COVID-19 kommen wird.
Ein Grund dafür ist, dass das Mpox-Virus keine neue Entdeckung ist. Wir haben bereits effektive Impfstoffe und Behandlungsmöglichkeiten für die Erkrankung. Außerdem breitet sich Mpox
Bei steigenden Fallzahlen sollte man auf jeden Fall vorsichtig sein. Allerdings gibt es zurzeit keinen Grund zur Panik
## Wie kann ich mich vor Mpox schützen?
Jeder kann sich mit Mpox infizieren und wiederum andere Menschen anstecken. Dies sind die besten Maßnahmen, um sich und andere zu schützen:[5](https://ada.com/de/editorial/monkeypox-what-we-know/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * Möglichst
  * Hautkontakt vermeiden mit Personen, die Symptome aufweisen
  * Das Tragen einer Maske wenn man sich in der Nähe von Menschen mit Symptomen befindet
  * Regelmäßiges Händewaschen
  * Das Putzen von Objekten und Oberflächen, die häufig berührt werden
  * Männer, die Sex mit Männern haben, sollten darüber nachdenken, den sexuellen Kontakt mit neuen Partnern zu begrenzen, bis der Ausbruch unter Kontrolle gebracht wurde

  2. del Rio C, Malani PN. Update on the Monkeypox Outbreak. JAMA.
  3. World Health Organisation [WHO]. Mpox. Fact Sheet. 
  4. Bunge EM, et al. The changing epidemiology of human monkeypox-A potential threat? A systematic review. PLoS Negl Trop Dis
  5. World Health Organisation [WHO]. Monkeypox: public health advice for gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men.

# Tension Headache
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on August 4, 2025 at 1:59 PM GMT+3
## On this page

## Overview
  * A tension headache is a harmless type of headache which can cause a tight feeling on both sides of the head
  * Tension headaches are caused by tense muscles of the head
  * Tension headache therapies focus on relieving your symptoms


Ada can help you understand your headache symptoms
A tension headache is a type of headache which occurs frequently
## What is a tension headache?
A tension headachetension-type headache[type of headache](https://ada.com/conditions/headache/#types-of-headaches) which can cause pain or a tight feeling on both sides of your head. You can feel this discomfort on the head, the scalp, or at the back of the neck. This condition is harmless and is assumed to be caused by stress and subsequent tightness of the muscles present on the head. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
## What does a tension headache feel like?
Tension headache symptoms [migraine headaches](https://ada.com/conditions/migraine-headache/), a tension headache can most commonly be felt on both sides of the head. The pain can be dull or can feel like a tight feeling or as if something is pressing on your head. The painful area can feel tender to the touch. [1](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Tension headaches usually don’t get worse from physical activity as opposed to some other types of headaches. In some cases, you may be more sensitive to strong lights and sounds. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")  
The pain of tension headaches is usually mild to moderate
## What causes a tension headache?
The exact causes of a tension headache are not well understood yet. A possible explanation is sustained contraction of the muscles of the head which causes them to become tense. This can happen due to:
  * stress
  * an injury 
  * or anxiety[3](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")


Other t causes [1](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
  * Interrupted or too little sleep
  * Consuming too much caffeine 
  * Not eating on time 
  * Taking too many painkillers 


## How long can a tension headache last?
How long tension headaches last can vary. In some cases, the headache can be relieved after as little as 30 minutesseveral days[1](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
## How can a tension headache be diagnosed?
In order to diagnose symptoms medical history [2](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
In some cases, your healthcare provider may ask you to keep a headache diary[2](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Feeling unwell? Get a symptom assessment with the [symptom checker](https://ada.com/app/) works before you try it for yourself.
## How to relieve a tension headache?
Tension headache treatment [1](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
  * Taking painkillers such as paracetamol, aspirin or ibuprofen in limited amounts, as overuse of this medication can also cause headaches [4](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
  * Doing activities that help you relax
  * Tackling sleep issues if present 
  * Dealing with stress in a healthy way


If your neck is feeling very tense, your healthcare provider may also recommend physical therapy. 
## How can you prevent tension headaches?
Tension headache selfcare
These measures include: [5](https://ada.com/conditions/tension-type-headache/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * A headache diary:
  * Stress relief and lifestyle changes:
  * Medication:


The lifestyle changes needed will vary from person to person, and it may take a period of trial and error before results can be seen.
## Other names for tension headache
  * Tension-type headache


## Wrapping up
Tension headaches are a common, but harmless condition which causes a dull, tight feeling on both sides of your head. Several lifestyle changes can help prevent and relieve tension headache symptoms. Some examples are doing activities that help you relax and get enough sleep. 
## Find out more about your symptoms
## Tension headache FAQs
Q: Where is a tension headache felt?   
A: A tension headache can hurt on both sides of your face, head, and neck. 
Q: Can a tension headache last for days?   
A: A tension headache can last anywhere between minutes and several days. You can relieve your symptoms with pain medication and lifestyle alterations to reduce your stress levels and improve your sleep. 
Q: How to get rid of a tension headache?   
A: You can treat a tension headache by taking over-the-counter pain medication. The use of this medication should be limited,
Q: Can anxiety cause tension headaches?   
A: Several factors such as stress, anxiety, and depression can be a cause for tension headaches, as they may increase the tension in the muscles on the head.

# How can I delete my account?
Deleting your Ada account permanently removes it and all associated data from our servers. Once an account is deleted, it cannot be restored.
To delete your Ada account, follow these steps:
  1. Open the Ada app and log in.
  2. Tap ⚙️(Settings)
  3. Choose Account login 
  4. Select Delete account
  5. Confirm your decision by tapping Delete


If you are not able to access the app, you can request account deletion by sending an email to support@ada.com. To delete an account, you must contact us via the same email address used to create the account so we can confirm it belongs to you. 
In certain circumstances, Ada is both legally required and permitted to retain some data. To this extent, your data will not be deleted but will only be processed for those purposes. For more information about how your data is handled when your account is deleted, please review our [Privacy Policy](https://ada.com/privacy-policy/) and refer to our [additional FAQ](https://ada.com/help/) on this topic.
Have more questions? [Submit a request](https://ada.com/contact/support/)

  * [Das Wichtigste auf einen Blick](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#das-wichtigste-auf-einen-blick)
  * [FAQs](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#faqs)

Artikel teilen:
## Überblick
Ein Hautausschlag ist ein mögliches Symptom einer Coronavirus-Infektion bei Erwachsenen
  * Hautausschläge aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion können an jeder Stelle des Körpers auftreten.
  * Es gibt keine bestimmte Form oder Größe der Hautausschläge.
  * Ein Hautausschlag, der von Coronaviren verursacht wurde, dauert meistens nicht lange – oftmals nur ein paar Tage bis Wochen.
  * Die Hautausschläge lassen sich mit verschiedenen rezeptfreien Medikamenten behandeln. 


Finde mehr über Deine Symptome heraus.
## Was ist ein von Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag?
Die genaue Ursache des von Coronaviren verursachten Hautausschlags ist noch nicht vollständig geklärt[1](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Diese Immunreaktion kann Entzündungen in verschiedenen Körperteilen und -stellen auslösen – auch in der Haut. Durch die entzündlichen Vorgänge können sich die Blutgefäße in der Haut erweitern, was schließlich zu einem Hautausschlag führen kann.
Hautausschläge entwickeln sich nicht bei allen Erwachsenen[mit einer Coronavirus-Infektion](https://ada.com/de/covid/). Allerdings zeigen Studiendaten, dass es bei 10 % der Menschen mit COVID-19 zu einer Hautreaktion kommt. Es ist unklar, ob Hautausschläge bei den neuen Coronavirus-Varianten häufiger auftreten. [1](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [2](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
Mit der [Ada-App](https://ada.com/de/app/) kannst Du Deine Symptome ganz einfach checken. 
## Ist ein von Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag ansteckend?
Wichtig zu wissen: Ein von Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag ist selbst nicht ansteckendnicht auf andere Menschen übertragen
Allerdings hat eine Person mit einem COVID-19-bedingten Hautausschlag das Coronavirus im Körper und kann es weitergeben. Daher ist es wichtig, dass Du Maßnahmen gegen die weitere Verbreitung des Coronavirus triffst, auch wenn Hautausschlag Dein einziges Symptom ist.
## Wie sieht ein von Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag aus und wie fühlt er sich an?
Ein Hautausschlag aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion kann sich in vielfältiger Weise und an verschiedenen Körperstellen
Ein von Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag kann jucken oder schmerzhaft sein. Außerdem kann er zu Hautverfärbungen und Hautschwellungen führen.
Ein Hautausschlag aufgrund einer Coronaviren-Infektion kann beispielsweise folgendermaßen aussehen[2](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [4](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") [5](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * Rosafarbene, flache oder leicht erhabene Hautausschläge, die Masern ähneln
  * Erhabene rote oder hautfarbene Beulen auf der Haut oder Nesselsucht
  * Kleine flüssigkeitsgefüllte Bläschen
  * Schmerzhafte rote und geschwollene Finger oder Zehen
  * Hautausschläge aufgrund von Blutgerinnseln in kleinen Blutgefäßen, die eine verminderte Durchblutung der betroffenen Hautstellen verursachen


## Wie lange dauert ein von Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag an?
Wenn Du an COVID-19 erkrankt bist und einen Hautausschlag entwickelt hast, dauert es meistens etwa eine Woche, bis er abklingt[4](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
In seltenen Fällen können Menschen mit einem von Coronaviren verursachten Hautausschlag 6 bis 12 Monate lang Beschwerden aufweisen – beispielsweise bei den sogenannten „[COVID-Zehen](https://ada.com/de/covid/covid-19-zehen/)“. [6](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
## Wie kann ein durch Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag diagnostiziert werden?
Ein Hautausschlag aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion geht sehr häufig mit anderen [COVID-19-Symptomen wie Fieber](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-fieber/) oder Muskel- und Gelenkschmerzen einher. Bei einem entsprechenden Verdacht wird Dich Dein:e Ärzt:in deshalb nach anderen Beschwerden fragen.
Ein durch Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag kann einigen anderen viral bedingten Ausschlägen[Windpocken](https://ada.com/de/conditions/acute-varicella-zoster/), Masern oder Herpes simplex ähneln[2](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Wenn Du Dir unsicher bist, ob diese Beschwerden auf Dich zutreffen, starte eine 
## Wie wird ein durch Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag behandelt?
Meistens handelt es sich bei einem Hautausschlag aufgrund einer [Coronaviren-Infektion](https://ada.com/de/conditions/diabetes-mellitus-type-2/) nicht um eine ernsthafte Erkrankung, da er kein großes Risiko für den allgemeinen Gesundheitszustand darstellt. Allerdings kann der Hautausschlag unangenehm oder schmerzhaft sein und bei manchen Menschen mit Blick auf das Aussehen verunsichern. Die Behandlung von Erwachsenen mit einem von Coronaviren verursachten Hautausschlag
Zusätzlich zur COVID-19-Therapie kann der Hautausschlag beispielsweise mit den folgenden rezeptpflichtigen Medikamenten behandelt werden: [7](https://ada.com/de/covid/hautausschlag-corona/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7")
  * Kortikosteroide („Kortison“)
  * Antihistaminika, mit denen man beispielsweise Allergien behandelt
  * Antikoagulanzien (Blutverdünner)


Wichtig ist, dass Du ärztlichen Rat einholst, wenn Du Dir Sorgen wegen des von Coronaviren verursachten Hautausschlags oder [anderer COVID-19-Symptome machst](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-symptome/).
## Das Wichtigste auf einen Blick
Ein von Coronaviren verursachter Hautausschlag gehört zu den seltenen COVID-19-Symptomen. Er ist nicht ansteckend und kann allein oder zusammen mit anderen Symptomen auftreten – darunter Fieber sowie [Muskel](https://ada.com/de/covid/muskelschmerzen-corona/)- oder [Gelenkschmerzen](https://ada.com/de/covid/gelenkschmerzen-corona/).
Die genaue Ursache des Hautausschlags aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion ist noch nicht vollständig geklärt. Man vermutet jedoch, dass er mit der Immunreaktion auf das Coronavirus zusammenhängt. Der Hautausschlag ist in der Regel nicht schwerwiegend und kann mit rezeptfreien Cremes oder Lotionen behandelt werden.

# Síndrome do intestino irritável
Escrito pelo nosso [Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/pt/team/medical/)
Atualizado em 1 de abril de 2022 às 08:41 GMT+2
## Nesta página
  * [Visão geral](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/irritable-bowel-syndrome/#visao-geral)
  * [Riscos](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/irritable-bowel-syndrome/#riscos)
  * [Sintomas](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/irritable-bowel-syndrome/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/irritable-bowel-syndrome/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamento](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/irritable-bowel-syndrome/#tratamento)
  * [Prognóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/irritable-bowel-syndrome/#prognostico)


* * *
Compartilhe esse artigo:
## Visão geral
A síndrome do intestino irritável é uma doença de longa duração que afecta o cólon (intestino grosso). Essa síndrome do intestino irritável é comum, e especialmente diagnosticada em jovens e mulheres. As suas causas não são completamente compreendidos, mas parece que contribuem o estresse e sensibilidade a certos alimentos. Os principais sintomas são dor de barriga, inchaço e diarreia ou intestino preso. É importante uma avaliação médica para excluir outras possíveis causas para os sintomas antes de dar o diagnóstico da síndrome do intestino irritável. Embora essa síndrome não possa ser tratada ou curada, muita gente acha que pode evitar coisas que fazem seus sintomas piorarem, e que estes melhoram ao longo do tempo.
## Riscos
A síndrome do intestino irritável tende a afetar mais frequentemente as mulheres do que homens. Esta condição tende a ser mais diagnosticada em pessoas jovens, embora possa afetar pessoas de todas as idades. As causas da síndrome do intestino irritável não são totalmente compreendidas, mas supõe-se que o estresse e sensibilidade a certos alimentos contribuam.
## Sintomas
Os sintomas da síndrome do intestino irritável podem variar muito de pessoa para pessoa. Os sintomas mais comuns são dor abdominal, cólicas, inchaço, gases, diarreia ou prisão de ventre e muco nas fezes. Os sintomas podem melhorar após a evacuação. Os sintomas podem ser desencadeados por estresse ou alimentos, e estes podem variar de uma pessoa para outra.
## Diagnóstico
O diagnóstico é feito por um médico que avalia os sintomas e faz um exame físico. É importante que o médico exclua outras causas possíveis para os sintomas antes de fazer um diagnóstico da síndrome do intestino irritável, e isso pode envolver alguns exames. Pode-se pedir à pessoa que mantenha um diário alimentar para ver quais alimentos pioram sistematicamente os sintomas. Pode-se fazer um endoscopia gastrointestinal (uma longa câmera introduzida através da boca ou ânus para olhar o estômago e intestinos). Outros testes podem incluir testes de sangue, testes de respiração para a intolerância à lactose, raios-X ou uma tomografia computorizada (CT).
## Tratamento
Não existe um tratamento que vise especificamente a síndrome do intestino irritável, mas existem várias formas de aliviar os sintomas. Para muita gente, é útil evitar alimentos que desencadeiam os sintomas. Estes incluem (entre muitos outros) alimentos que causam gases (brócolis, couve, feijão), alimentos gordurosos e alimentos com cafeína. Muitas pessoas acham que ajuda fazer exercício regularmente. O estresse pode ser um gatilho importante de sintomas. Aprender a gerir o estresse pode ser benéfico. Medicação pode ajudar no alívio da obstipação ou da diarreia.
## Prognóstico
Embora a síndrome do intestino irritável seja uma condição que não pode ser curada, muitas pessoas aprendem a controlar seus sintomas e descobrem que estes melhoram ao longo do tempo. A maioria das pessoas não desenvolve quaisquer complicações a longo prazo, como resultado desta condição.

# Poliovirus Infection
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on March 28, 2022 at 10:52 AM GMT+2
## On this page
  * [What is a poliovirus infection?](https://ada.com/conditions/poliovirus-infection/#what-is-a-poliovirus-infection)
  * [Risks of polio infection](https://ada.com/conditions/poliovirus-infection/#risks-of-polio-infection)
  * [Symptoms of polio](https://ada.com/conditions/poliovirus-infection/#symptoms-of-polio)
  * [Diagnosing polio infection](https://ada.com/conditions/poliovirus-infection/#diagnosing-polio-infection)
  * [Polio infection treatment](https://ada.com/conditions/poliovirus-infection/#polio-infection-treatment)
  * [Prevention](https://ada.com/conditions/poliovirus-infection/#prevention)
  * [Other names for poliovirus infection](https://ada.com/conditions/poliovirus-infection/#other-names-for-poliovirus-infection)


* * *
Share this article:
## What is a poliovirus infection?
Poliovirus infection is a infectious condition caused by the poliovirus. This virus infects the nervous system and may lead to muscle weakness or paralysis (inability to move muscles at all). This condition is very uncommon as immunization has caused the virus to be eradicated from many countries.
People who are not immunized against polio and who travel to areas where the poliovirus is still active have a risk of getting a polio infection. Children under 5 years of age are most commonly affected.
Polio symptoms may include:
  * fever
  * sore throat
  * headaches
  * aching muscles.


Some, but not all, people go on to develop muscle weakness. Poliovirus infection cannot be cured and the treatment usually only controls the symptoms. The outlook after a poliovirus infection depends on the severity of the symptoms, but it can cause permanent disability and death.
If you are worried that you or someone you know may have this condition, use the [symptom checker](https://ada.com/app/) works.
## Risks of polio infection
Polio is caused by the polio virus. The virus is transmitted through direct contact with an infected person or through infected mucus and feces. Although this virus has been removed from most countries in the world, episodes or outbreak of polio still occur.
Outbreaks tend to occur more commonly in the summer months. Although people of any age group can become infected, children under the age of 5 years are most commonly affected. The people who are not vaccinated against polio and who travel to areas where poliovirus is still active are at risk of getting infected.
## Symptoms of polio
Early symptoms of a poliovirus infection resemble the flu and include fever, headache, vomiting, feeling ill and sore throat. These symptoms will often get better within a few days, and most people will have no further symptoms.
If the virus spreads to the nervous system, it can cause muscle weakness in the legs, arms, back or neck. This can cause problems walking and completing tasks, and even difficulty breathing. Over time, this causes tight joints, shrinking of the muscles (atrophy) or even paralysis. Symptoms may come back years after the original infection, causing the post-polio syndrome
Think you might be experiencing symptoms of poliovirus infection?
## Diagnosing polio infection
The diagnosis can be made based on the symptoms and physical examination when it is known that a person is not immunized and has been to an area where they may have been exposed to the virus. Blood tests for immune proteins which fight the poliovirus (antibodies) and a lumbar puncture (taking a sample of fluid from around the spinal cord) are often done to confirm the diagnosis and to investigate for the virus in the nervous system.
## Polio infection treatment
There is no specific cure for poliovirus infection. Treatment aims to relieve symptoms. This may mean simple pain relief for headaches and muscle aches.
People with ongoing muscle weakness may need physical therapy to help improve muscle strength. If the breathing muscles are affected and become weak, the affected person may need a machine to help with breathing.
## Prevention
Poliovirus infection can be prevented through vaccination. It is important to keep to the recommended vaccination schedule.
## Other names for poliovirus infection
  * Polio
  * Infantile paralysis
  * Poliomyelitis

# Gastroenteritis viral pediátrica
Escrito por nuestro [Equipo de Profesionales Médicos](https://ada.com/es/team/medical/)
Actualizado el 24 de agosto de 2022, 9:18 EET
## En esta página
  * [Resumen](https://ada.com/es/conditions/pediatric-viral-gastroenteritis/#resumen)
  * [Riesgos](https://ada.com/es/conditions/pediatric-viral-gastroenteritis/#riesgos)

Comparte este artículo:
## Resumen
La gastroenteritis viral, llamada también 'gripe estomacal' o 'daño estomacal', es una inflamación del estómago y los intestinos causada por un virus. Suele contagiarse por el contacto con una persona infectada. Los síntomas principales son vómitos, diarrea y malestar o dolor de vientre (estómago). Los síntomas suelen durar solo algunos días. Además, es muy importante que los niños afectados se mantengan bien hidratados mientras no se sienta bien.
¿Te sientes mal? Revisa tus síntomas con la app gratuita de Ada. O también descubre cómo funciona nuestro verificador de síntomas antes de probar nuestra app.
## Riesgos
La gastroenteritis viral suele transmitirse de una persona a otra a través del contacto cercano o al tocar superficies y objetos que se comparten. Comer alimentos preparados por una persona que tiene el virus cuyas manos no están limpias puede ser también una fuente de infección.
## Síntomas
Los síntomas típicos incluyen diarrea líquida y vómitos. Los niños más crecidos pueden quejarse de malestar o dolor de vientre (estómago), mientras que los niños pequeños pueden estar irritables o puede ser difícil alimentarlos. Otros signos de infección pueden incluir fiebre, escalofríos, dolores musculares y un sarpullido en la piel. Si la gastroenteritis lleva a una deshidratación, los signos importantes en niños incluyen labios secos, orinar menos cantidades de orina (menos pañales mojados en bebes), ojos hundidos y somnolencia.
## Diagnóstico
El diagnóstico suele hacerse basándose en los síntomas. A veces es necesario hacer un análisis de la materia fecal para determinar la causa viral específica.
## Tratamiento
La mayoría de los casos de gastroenteritis viral mejoran sin recibir tratamiento específico. Los niños que tienen gastroenteritis viral deben descansar y tomar una cantidad abundante de líquidos. Puede ser de ayuda ofrecerles pequeñas cantidades de líquido para que beban seguidamente, aunque las bebidas con azúcar deben evitarse ya que pueden empeorar la diarrea. El amamantamiento o la alimentación mediante leche de fórmula debe continuar si es posible. Si un niño no puede beber suficiente líquido o si muestra signos de una deshidratación debe ser evaluado urgentemente en una consulta médica, ya que es posible que necesite que lo admitan en el hospital para recibir líquidos por goteo (intravenosos).
## Prevención
Mantener una buena higiene es importante para prevenir esta condición médica. Esto es especialmente importante cuando se está cuidando a niños que tienen gastroenteritis viral con el fin de evitar que el virus se siga propagando. Por último, para prevenir también existen vacunas disponibles contra algunos de los virus que causan la gastroenteritis, como el rotavirus.
## Pronóstico
Este problema suele resolverse en algunos días. Los niños muy pequeños o los que tienen otros problemas de salud podrían tener un riesgo más alto de complicaciones, incluida la deshidratación grave.
## Aprende más acerca de tus síntomas

# How do I export my assessment?
It’s easy to export an assessment. Here’s how:
  1. Open the Ada app.
  2. Log in to your account using the original sign-in method.
  3. Select Profiles
  4. Choose the desired profile.
  5. Tap Health assessments
  6. Choose the assessment that you want to view.
  7. Pick the menu in the top-right corner, and select the share option to generate a PDF.

# COVID-19 symptoms vs. allergies
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on March 7, 2025 at 3:00 PM GMT+2
## On this page
  * [Overview](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#overview)
  * [What causes allergies?](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#what-causes-allergies)
  * [COVID-19 symptoms vs. allergies](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#covid-19-symptoms-vs-allergies)
  * [Duration](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#duration)
  * [Diagnosing](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#diagnosing)
  * [Treatments](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#treatments)
  * [Wrapping up](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#wrapping-up)
  * [FAQs](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#faqs)


* * *
Share this article:
## Overview
  * Allergies and a COVID-19 infection can have similar symptoms
  * Allergy symptoms are caused by allergens, such as pollen or dust mites, while COVID is caused by a virus
  * Unlike allergies, COVID symptoms will often be accompanied by a fever or a general feeling of unwell
  * There are distinct tests to determine whether you have COVID or allergies


Think you might be experiencing COVID-19 symptoms
Allergies or COVID-19
## What causes allergies?
Unlike COVID-19, which is caused by a virus, allergies are caused by allergens[you can get certain symptoms that may look like COVID-19 symptoms](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-symptoms/). [1](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Concerned that you or a loved one may have COVID-19? Start your symptom assessment in the [app](https://ada.com/app/) first.
## COVID-19 symptoms vs. allergies
The symptoms of COVID-19 and allergies
An infection with the coronavirus[change to your sense of smell or taste,](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-symptom-metallic-taste/) an overall unwell feeling, and [a continuous cough](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-symptom-cough/) you didn't have before. People who suffer from allergies don't tend to have a fever, and most don't feel unwell. 
Apart from this, allergies respond profoundly to antihistamines and nasal sprays, unlike in COVID-19.
Allergies may cause milder symptoms than COVID-19
If you have allergies[2](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
  * Sneezing and coughing
  * A runny or blocked nose
  * Watery or red eyes
  * Itchy throat, eyes, mouth, nose, or ears
  * Itchy skin or a raised rash
  * Loss of smell
  * Headache or pain around your temples and forehead
  * Pain or tenderness around your cheeks, ears, eyes, or forehead
  * Feeling tired
  * Wheezing or breathlessness 
  * Swelling of the eyes, lips, mouth, or throat 


If you know that you have allergies and you recognize your symptoms from previous years when there was a lot of pollen in the air, then your symptoms are probably due to your allergies. You can be even more certain if your symptoms decrease after taking antihistamines or after using a nasal spray. If you have symptoms that include a new cough or a [loss of taste or smell](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-symptom-loss-of-taste-and-smell/) with a fever, you should stay away from others and [get tested for COVID as soon as possible](https://ada.com/covid/). [3](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
The table below outlines the differences between COVID-19 and allergies: [4](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")[5](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [6](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6") [7](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7")
Symptoms  | COVID-19 | Seasonal Allergies  
---|---|---  
Fever | Yes | No  
Sneeze | Sometimes | Yes  
Dry cough | Sometimes | Sometimes  
Nasal Congestion | Yes | Sometimes  
Runny Nose | Yes | Sometimes  
Sore Throat | Sometimes | Sometimes  
Itchy Throat | No | Yes  
Itchy or Watery Eyes | No | Yes  
Itchy Skin or a Raised Rash | Rarely | Rarely  
Loss of Smell | Sometimes | Rarely  
Headache | Sometimes | Sometimes  
Pain around Cheeks, Ears, Eyes, or Forehead | Rarely | Sometimes  
Tiredness | Yes | Sometimes  
Muscle Aches | Yes | Rarely  
Shortness of Breath | Yes | Sometimes  
Nausea or Vomiting | Sometimes | No  
Diarrhea | Sometimes | Rarely  
Extreme Exhaustion | Sometimes | Rarely  
## Duration of allergies vs. COVID-19
Allergies usually last for as long as the allergen remains present
Compared to allergies, symptoms related to the coronavirus usually last a shorter[it may be considered long COVID](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-long-covid/). [3](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3") [8](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") [9](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") [10](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")
## Diagnosing an allergy or COVID-19
If you suspect you have COVID-19, you'll need a COVID test to confirm your diagnosis. There are 2 main types of COVID tests available:
  * PCR test
  * Antigen test


If you believe allergiescombination of tests[3](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
  * Allergy tests
  * Blood tests


## Treatment of an allergy vs. COVID-19
If you're experiencing allergy symptoms, there are several ways to alleviate symptoms[3](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-vs-allergies/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
  * Avoiding the thing you're allergic to when possible
  * Antihistamines
  * Steroid tablets
  * Steroid creams
  * Adrenaline auto-injectors, such as an EpiPen, for severe allergic reactions
  * Desensitization therapy (immunotherapy), which involves gradually exposing you to the allergen over time for your body to get used to it


If you're infected with COVID your possible treatment depends on your symptoms. [Read Ada's article about COVID treatments](https://ada.com/covid/treatment-guide/) to find out more.
Instead here, the table below outlines the different treatments for COVID-19 and Allergies. 
| COVID-19 | Allergies  
---|---|---  
Prevention | 
  * Recommended vaccinations 
  * Face masks 
  * Isolation of infected people

| 
  * Controlling the environment
  * Avoiding contact with allergens

  
Treatments | 
  * [Antiviral drugs](https://ada.com/covid/antiviral-medication/) as soon as possible after the onset of the symptoms, best within 5 days. 
  * Other medications like antibodies, pain killers following doctors’ recommendation

| 
  * Eyedrops
  * Nasal sprays
  * Antihistaminic medication 
  * Corticoids

  
Occurrence | 
  * After contact with an infected person, during “waves.” 
  * Higher incidence in colder months

| 
  * Seasonally or repeatedly, depending on external factors like pollen

  
Ada does not make any medical diagnoses. Please seek the advice of a medical professional if you’re concerned about your health. In case of an emergency, you should contact the emergency services immediately. Always consult your doctor if you have any questions regarding medical issues. You should never disregard a doctor’s professional advice or cancel an appointment with a doctor because you’re relying on information you have read or heard on the Ada platform.
## Wrapping up
When experiencing symptoms like a runny nose, a headache, or a cough, you may wonder whether it’s allergies or COVID. Although some symptoms may be the same, there are some differences [such as a fever](https://ada.com/covid/covid-19-fever-range/) and feeling unwell which may indicate a COVID infection. If you are unsure, get tested and stay away from others until you have your test results.

# Research and Publications 
Objective and peer-reviewed research can raise the industry bar for quality, safety, and performance. Here's some research that looks at the performance and efficacy of Ada's technology.
Scroll through or navigate to a topic of interest below. 
[ Safety and accuracy ](https://about.ada.com/studies/#safety-and-accuracy) [ Patient experience ](https://about.ada.com/studies/#patient-experience) [ Global health and universal coverage ](https://about.ada.com/studies/#global-health-and-universal-coverage) [ Rare diseases ](https://about.ada.com/studies/#rare-diseases) [ Public health and surveillance ](https://about.ada.com/studies/#public-health-and-surveillance) [ Commentary and industry ](https://about.ada.com/studies/#commentary-and-industry)
## Safety and accuracy
  * China’s 8 most popular symptom checkers showed a range of coverage, safety, and accuracy, factors relevant to user and physician choice.
  * Ada offered the highest coverage (99.5%) and advice safety (99.5%) compared with the average (69.6% and 90.3%, respectively).
  * Ada’s accuracy was significantly higher, and more than twice the average (61.5% vs 28.7%).


Chinese Journal of General Practitioners, 2023
  * Ada was significantly more accurate in the recognition of inflammatory rheumatic diseases (IRD) than physicians (70% vs physicians' 54%), which included experienced rheumatology physicians.
  * Ada was more accurate than physicians in suggesting the correct final diagnosis (54% of cases vs physicians' 32%).
  * Highlights the potential of using symptom checkers early in the patient journey and the advantages of considering complete patient information to establish a correct diagnosis.
  * Shows the potential of symptom checkers to make accurate triage and diagnostic decisions in rheumatology.


Rheumatology International, 2022
  * Ada outperformed all other symptom checkers in suggesting the correct diagnosis for skin rashes.
  * Ada's top condition suggestion matched the correct diagnosis in 73.3% of cases, vs an average of 30.8%.
  * The correct diagnosis was provided within Ada's top three condition suggestions in 93.3% of instances vs an average of 43.3%.


Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology, 2022
  * Real-world hospital ED study of 378 patients, comparing the safety of Ada’s urgency advice to that of the Manchester Triage System (MTS).
  * Ada demonstrated a high rate of safety (94.7%) over all medical specialties of the Emergency Department, with a focus on Internal Medicine, Orthopedics and Trauma, and Neurology.
  * From the 3 lowest MTS categories, 43.4% could have safely accessed lower urgency care such as seeing a GP or managing their symptoms at home.
  * Ada has the potential to relieve pressure on Emergency Departments by guiding patients to lower urgency care if used at home.


JMIR mHealth and uHealth, 2022
  * One of Ada's top 5 condition suggestions matched therapist's formal diagnoses in 69% of cases, and Ada's top suggestion matched in 51% of cases.
  * Symptom checkers have potential to complement the mental health diagnostic process, but further investigation is recommended.
  * The usability of Ada was rated as high in the System Usability Scale.


JMIR Mental Health, 2022
  * When used in combination with ER physicians assessments, Ada significantly increased diagnostic accuracy (87.3%) compared with an ER physician alone (80.9%).
  * Patients with early diagnosis and rapid treatment allocation exhibited significantly reduced complications and length of hospital stay.
  * AI tools have the potential to benefit the diagnostic efficacy of clinicians and improve quality of care.


Annals of Surgery, 2022
  * One of Ada’s top 5 condition suggestions matched the correct diagnosis in 70% of cases, close to physicians' top 3 average of 68.9%.
  * 90% of patients found Ada easy to use, and 83% considered Ada to be an efficient way to document their medical problems quickly.
  * Ada’s correct ‘diagnoses’ were nearly identical to one of the board-certified emergency physicians'.


JMIR Mhealth Uhealth, 2022
  * Ada’s DDSS prototype could support doctors’ decision-making by showing them new pathways and potential diagnoses.
  * Ada provided accurate decision support in the clinical inpatient setting for people presenting with dyspnea.


JMIR Formative Research, 2022
  * Using a dataset from 464,547 patients, Ada's CVD risk prediction tool achieved superior performance to several established general CVD risk prediction models.
  * Ada could be used to direct individuals to app-based behavior change recommendations for risk reduction and guidance.


PLOS ONE, 2021
  * Ada identified the correct condition in the top 3 suggestions in 83% of cases, compared to the next best of 77%, including Australia-specific scenarios.
  * 63% of Ada’s urgency advice matched the gold standard, compared to the next highest app’s score of 52%


Australian Journal of Primary Health, 2021
  * Ada had 73% accuracy compared to a 38% all-app average.
  * Ada's exhibited 97% disposition safety compared to an 83% all-app average.


PLOS ONE, 2021
  * The utility of symptom checkers relies on safety, coverage, and accuracy.
  * Ada’s advice was safe in 97% of cases, on par with GPs and with 99% condition coverage for the clinical scenarios.
  * Ada showed 70% accuracy for top 3 suggestion fit vs competitor average of 38%.


BMJ Open, 2020
  * 46.4% of 26,646 Ada assessments were completed outside primary care clinic hours.
  * Ada’s recommendations were comparable to triage nurses’.


Journal of Medical Internet Research, 2020
  * Ada could help identify mental health disorders in adults.


JMIR Formative Research, 2019
  * Ada ranked highly on precision out of the 24 tested in the ear, nose, and throat (ENT) discipline.


HNO, 2019
  * Ada was the most accurate of the 4 apps tested.
  * Ada was found to be fast and easy to use.


Pulse Today, 2019
  * Ada was "by far the best" app out of the 4 tested, asking clear questions and providing the best condition suggestions.


Wired UK, 2017
## Patient experience
  * 93% of Ada’s assessments provided useful information prior to consultation with 83% of Ada’s top condition suggestions matching the physician’s primary diagnosis.
  * In 52% of appointments, Ada saved more than 1 minute of primary care consultation time.
  * Most physicians agreed that Ada is safe and effective, guiding patients to the correct care, providing useful information, and saving time in consultations.


Healthcare Information and Management Systems Society (HIMSS), 2023
  * Ada supported conversation and improved rapport for 90% of patients, 73% of physicians, and 100% of nurses.
  * Patients reported high usability and understood the tool’s questions.


JMIR Formative Research, 2022
  * Ada could decrease the average triage nurse waiting times by 54%.


JMIR Formative Research, 2021
  * 97.8% of patients rated Ada very or quite easy to use.
  * 12.8% or patients would have delayed their appointment or used lower-intensity care.


JMIR Human Factors, 2020
## Global health and universal coverage
  * The readability of Ada's consumer-facing medical text was reduced from grade 11, to grade 7 without compromising on medical quality.
  * AI companies can reduce the burden on vulnerable healthcare systems, but should be designed and adapted to the needs of the local population.
  * Efforts should be made to reduce bias in AI by using white-box systems.


Pending publication, The Lancet, 2022
  * Protocol for a clinical study set in a Tanzanian district hospital outpatient clinic to investigate the usefulness of a prototype diagnosis decision support system (DDSS) in the hands of a mid-level healthcare worker.
  * The diagnostic accuracy and qualitative data on the usability, usefulness, and acceptance of the prototype DDSS will provide insights on the appropriateness of the prototype DDSS interface.


JMIR Research Protocols, 2022
  * Protocol for first-of-type clinical study set in a Tanzanian district hospital outpatient clinic to investigate the usefulness of symptom assessment applications in LMICs.
  * Evaluation of Ada's compared to gold-standard differential diagnoses and triage advice for participants with various conditions and age groups, including children.


BMJ Open, 2022
  * Ada’s knowledge base was adapted to account for differences in incidence and disease presentation in South Africa, including optimizing 25 maternal and 25 pediatric conditions.
  * Ada’s readability was lowered from grade 11 level to below grade 8 level (7.4) while still maintaining medical accuracy to improve accessibility and uptake.
  * White-box AI like Ada, based on interpretable models that can be explained and easily understood by a human, can control and reduce data bias.


2022
  * AI solutions can only improve health outcomes in LMICs if they are designed and adapted with the needs of the local population in mind.

# Ebola-Viruskrankheit
Verfasst von [Adas medizinischem Fachpersonal](https://ada.com/de/team/medical/)
Aktualisiert am 15. Februar 2022 um 10:01 OEZ
## Auf dieser Seite

Artikel teilen:
## Was ist Ebola-Viruskrankheit?
Die Ebola-Viruskrankheit ist eine infektiöse Erkrankung, die durch das Ebola-Virus verursacht wird. Sie führt zu einer Krankheit, die durch Fieber und Blutungen geprägt ist.
Die Übertragung erfolgt durch direkten Kontakt mit kontaminierten Körperflüssigkeiten. Symptome treten gewöhnlich zwischen zwei und 21 Tagen auf und die betroffenen Personen sind ansteckend, sobald sie die ersten Symptome zeigen.
Es gibt noch keine Heilung, doch eine gute Versorgung der Betroffenen erhöht die Chancen, das Virus zu besiegen. Vorbeugende Maßnahmen zielen hauptsächlich darauf ab, die Übertragung des Virus einzudämmen.
## Was sind Risiken der Ebola-Viruskrankheit?
Diese Erkrankung wird durch ein hochansteckendes Virus
Der Kontakt mit Gegenständen, die mit diesen Flüssigkeiten kontaminiert sind, sowie der Kontakt mit Tieren oder Menschen, die an der Krankheit leiden, erhöhen das Infektionsrisiko. Obwohl es hochansteckend ist, so breitet sich das Virus nicht durch die Luft oder durch einfache Berührung eines Infizierten aus.
Das Ebola-Virus kommt in Westafrika vor, weshalb Menschen, die in Ländern mit Ebola leben oder in diese reisen, einem erhöhten Infektionsrisiko ausgesetzt sind.
## Was sind Ebola-Viruskrankheit Symptome?
Die Symptome einer Ebola-Infektion treten gewöhnlich zwischen zwei und 21 Tagen nach der Infektion auf. Menschen mit einer Ebola-Infektion sind ansteckend, sobald sie die ersten Symptome zeigen.
Die frühen Symptome[Ähnlichkeit mit jenen einer Grippe oder Malaria](https://ada.com/de/conditions/influenza-infection/), wie z.B.:
  * Fieber,
  * Schweißausbrüche,
  * Muskelschmerzen und
  * Kopfschmerzen.


Zu den spätere Symptome
  * Magenschmerzen,
  * Durchfall,
  * Erbrechen sowie
  * Blutergüsse und Blutungen aus Mund, Augen, Ohren und im Darm.


Wenn Du Dir unsicher bist, ob diese Beschwerden auf Dich zutreffen, starte eine 
## Wie wird die Ebola-Viruskrankheit diagnostiziert?
Die frühen Symptome einer Ebola-Infektion haben große Ähnlichkeit mit jenen einer Grippe oder Malaria, wodurch eine frühzeitige Diagnose schwierig sein kann.
Zur Bestätigung einer Infektion durch das Ebola-Virus werden Bluttests
## Wie wird die Ebola-Viruskrankheit behandelt?
Derzeit gibt es keine Heilung und keinen lizenzierten Impfstoffmedizinische Versorgung ist erforderlich,
## Wie sieht die Prognose bei der Ebola-Viruskrankheit aus?
Eine Prognose ist schwierig, da Menschen sehr unterschiedlich auf das Virus reagieren
## Kann man der Ebola-Viruskrankheit vorbeugen?
Vorbeugende Maßnahmen sind sehr wichtig, um einen Ausbruch dieses Virus zu kontrollieren. Personen mit einer Ebola-Infektion sind ansteckend, sobald sie die ersten Symptome zeigen. Wenn bei einer Person also die Gefahr besteht, an Ebola erkrankt zu sein, so ist wichtig, achtsam zu sein, bis die Ursache für die Krankheit bestätigt wurde.
Die Verbreitung dieses Virus kann eingedämmt werden, indem der ungeschützte Kontakt mit infizierten Körperflüssigkeiten bei der Versorgung von Personen mit einer Ebola-Infektion vermieden wird und vorbeugende Maßnahmen bei Beerdigungen von Menschen, die an Ebola gestorben sind, getroffen werden.

# At-home Testosterone Test
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on May 15, 2025 at 12:44 PM GMT+3
## On this page
  * [What is a testosterone test?](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#what-is-a-testosterone-test)

    * [Low testosterone levels in boys](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#low-testosterone-levels-in-boys)

  * [Interpreting testosaterone test result](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#interpreting-testosaterone-test-result)

Share this article:
A testosterone test[testosterone page](https://ada.com/hormones/testosterone/) explains the functions of testosterone in the body. In this article, we talk about how to get testosterone tested and some of the signs of testosterone imbalance in men and women.
Do you think that your testosterone levels might be too low or too high
## What is a testosterone test?
A testosterone test measures the amount of testosterone in the blood[sex hormone](https://ada.com/hormones/). [1](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Hormones are chemical messengers which travel in the blood. Both men and women need testosterone in their bodies but women have lower levels of testosterone than men (about one-tenth). [2](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
Do you think that your testosterone levels might be too low or too highsymptom checker works before you try it for yourself.
## How to test testosterone levels?
There are two waysblood sample from a vein[3](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
## How to test testosterone levels at home?
The testosterone test kit is a finger prick test and the test kit contains a finger prick device. It is best to do the finger prick test when your body is warm, for example after a warm bath or shower. This means that the blood vessels near your skin are expanded, so it will be easier to collect blood from the finger. 
The test kit will tell you whether you should take the test in the morning. Testosterone test costs can vary and usually depends on the test provider, whether other tests are included, and whether a doctor checks the result. It is important to carefully read and follow the instructions in an at-home test kit. [5](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
## What blood test checks testosterone levels?
Testosterone moves through blood either free or bound to [sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG)](https://ada.com/hormones/sex-hormone-binding-globulin-shgb/). SHBG is a protein, made by the liver, which binds to [sex hormones ](https://ada.com/hormones/)in the blood. A total testosterone blood test measures all the testosterone in the blood, both free and bound. To compare free and total testosterone, SHBG levels and a free androgen index are checked. A free androgen index compares how much testosterone is free in the blood and how much of it is bound to SHBG. [6](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
## When to have a testosterone test?
A testosterone test can be useful if you are concerned that your testosterone level is too high or too low. You should speak to your doctor if you’re worried about this.
### Signs of low testosterone in men
There are some visible signs of low testosterone[7](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7")
  * [Erectile dysfunction](https://ada.com/conditions/erectile-dysfunction/)
  * Decreased libido
  * Gynecomastia (enlargement of breast tissue)
  * Infertility 
  * Muscle loss (uncommon)
  * Loss of body hair


There are other causes of these symptoms so it is always important to speak to a doctor to help to assess what the problem is. If you and your partner are having difficulty getting pregnant, it is important that you both see a doctor.
Conditions which cause damage to the testes can also cause low testosterone: [3](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
  * Physical injury to the testes
  * [Mumps](https://ada.com/conditions/mumps/) (a viral infection)
  * High alcohol intake


High testosterone in men[3](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
### Signs of low testosterone in boys
In boys, a sign of low testosterone is delayed puberty. A sign of high testosterone is early puberty. You should speak to a doctor if you are concerned about either of these conditions.
### Signs of high testosterone in women
Signs that testosterone levels of women are too high are: [1](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [3](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
  * Excessive growth of facial and body hair
  * Difficulty in getting pregnant
  * [Acne](https://ada.com/conditions/acne-vulgaris/)
  * Having no periods or irregular periods


These are also symptoms of [polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS)](https://ada.com/conditions/polycystic-ovary-syndrome/)
Testosterone levels decline with age but too low testosterone is uncommon in women. Low testosterone levels may link to reduced sex drive for some women who have gone through menopause. [8](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") There are many other causes of low sex drive and you should consider speaking to your doctor if you are concerned. 
Do you think that your testosterone levels might be too low or too high
##  What does the test result mean?
It is best to speak to your doctor when interpreting the results of a testosterone lab test. 
In menconsidered low[9](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") It is normal for testosterone levels in men to fall as you get older. [3](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
In womenconsidered high[10](https://ada.com/hormones/at-home-testosterone-test/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")
A doctor will consider your symptoms and may perform a physical examination alongside the testosterone test results. Depending on the results, your doctor may discuss further investigations and refer you to a specialist.
## Find out more about your symptoms
## Testosterone test FAQs
Q: What is a testosterone test?  
A: A testosterone test is a blood test, which measures the level of the hormone testosterone in the blood.
Q: How can I find a testosterone test near me?  
A: Your doctor or sexual health clinic can perform a testosterone test. Alternatively, you can order testosterone testing online. An at-home testosterone test is a finger prick test that you can use yourself. You post the blood test sample to a laboratory, which will analyze the blood to give a test result.
Q: When should I seek advice from a doctor?  
A: You should speak to your doctor if you are concerned that you might have a 
Q: If my testosterone is low, should I take testosterone supplements?  
A: Depending on the cause of low testosterone, testosterone supplements are sometimes used as a treatment. Not all causes of low testosterone will respond to testosterone supplements. Testosterone supplements can cause significant health problems if taken without supervision. This is why you should speak to your doctor before taking testosterone supplements.

# Testicular Cancer
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on February 15, 2022 at 10:00 AM GMT+2
## On this page
  * [What is testicular cancer?](https://ada.com/conditions/testicular-cancer/#what-is-testicular-cancer)
  * [Risks of testicular cancer](https://ada.com/conditions/testicular-cancer/#risks-of-testicular-cancer)
  * [Testicular cancer Symptoms](https://ada.com/conditions/testicular-cancer/#testicular-cancer-symptoms)
  * [Diagnosis](https://ada.com/conditions/testicular-cancer/#diagnosis)
  * [Treating testicular cancer](https://ada.com/conditions/testicular-cancer/#treating-testicular-cancer)
  * [Prevention](https://ada.com/conditions/testicular-cancer/#prevention)


* * *
Share this article:
## What is testicular cancer?
Testicular cancer is a rare cancer that arises from the testicles. The testicles are male reproductive organs within the scrotum (scrotal sac) that produce sperm and the male hormone, [testosterone](https://ada.com/hormones/testosterone/). It is the most common cancer in young men between ages 15 and 35. The most common symptoms of testicular cancer are a painless lump or swelling in either testicle and a feeling of heaviness in the scrotum.
However the cancer may show no symptoms. Surgical removal of the cancer is the primary treatment. Other treatment options are generally based on the stage of testicular cancer. Many people recover well after treatment for testicular cancer.
## Risks of testicular cancer
Cancer occurs when abnormal cells grow uncontrollably. These cells destroy the healthy cells around them and can spread into other parts of the body. Testicular cancer occurs when this takes place in the testicle. Although testicular cancer is one of the less common cancers overall, it is one of the most common solid cancers in men between the ages of 20 and 35. Older men and younger boys also can get this cancer, but this is less common.
The cause of testicular cancer is not known. Men who have a family member who has had testicular cancer may be more likely to also develop testicular cancer. Men with [HIV](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/), who had an undescended testicle as a child (a condition where the testicle is not in the scrotum) or who have a chromosomal condition called Klinefelter syndrome also have a higher risk of developing testicular cancer.
## Testicular cancer Symptoms
The most common symptoms is a painless lump or swelling affecting the testicle. Other symptoms include a feeling of heaviness, pain or swelling of the scrotum (the muscular bag which holds the testicles). Some people feel the pain and heaviness in the lower part of their abdomen. Some men may develop breast tissue, but this is uncommon.
## Diagnosis
The diagnosis is made based on the physical examination of the scrotum, blood tests and a ultrasound scan of the scrotum and CT scan of the abdomen. The diagnosis is confirmed when a small sample (biopsy) of the testicle shows cancer. Further scans and tests may be done to see if the cancer has spread.
## Treating testicular cancer
Treatment depends on the size of the cancer, the specific type of cancer, and whether it has spread elsewhere in the body. This determines the stage of the cancer. In most cases, the cancer and affected testicle will be surgically removed. Chemotherapy and radiation therapy are chosen depending on the stage and type of testicular cancer.
The treating doctor can give the best advice in individual cases. These treatments can cause infertility. If the man would like to have children in the future, sperm banking before treatment is an option. Emotional support via individual counseling or a support group is helpful in coming to terms with the diagnosis and while undergoing treatment.
## Prevention
Self examination of the testicles can help to detect testicular cancer in early stages, which could be helpful in successful treatment.

## Überblick
KopfschmerzenCoronavirus-Infektionersten Symptome
  * Kopfschmerzen können eines der ersten Symptome einer Coronavirus-Infektion sein.
  * Meistens dauern Kopfschmerzen, die durch Coronaviren verursacht werden, nur ein paar Tage an.
  * COVID-19-bedingte Kopfschmerzen können wie andere Kopfschmerzen behandelt werden: Ruhe, viel Trinken, kühle Kompressen und gegebenenfalls rezeptfreie Schmerzmittel
  * Kopfschmerzen können auch häufig bei einem milden COVID-19-Verlauf auftreten.


Einige Studien deuten an, dass Kopfschmerzen einen Hinweis auf den weiteren Verlauf einer Coronavirus-Infektion geben können. Daher können sie wichtige Anhaltspunkte für die Diagnose und die Behandlungsstrategie liefern. Wichtig zu wissen: Obwohl COVID-19 häufig Kopfschmerzen einhergeht, werden nicht alle Kopfschmerzen durch eine Coronavirus-Infektion verursacht und nicht alle Menschen mit COVID-19 haben Kopfschmerzen.
Finde mehr über Deine Symptome heraus.
## Was sind Kopfschmerzen aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion?
Kopfschmerzen sind ein häufiges Symptom bei COVID-19. Sie treten meist zusammen mit anderen Symptomen auf, die denen einer Virus-Grippe oder Erkältung ähneln, wie zum Beispiel: [1](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [2](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
  * [hohes Fieber](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-fieber/)
  * [Husten](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-husten/)
  * [Geruchs- oder Geschmacksverlust](https://ada.com/de/covid/geruchs-und-geschmacksverlust-corona/)
  * [Kurzatmigkeit](https://ada.com/de/covid/kurzatmigkeit-corona/)
  * [Halsschmerzen](https://ada.com/de/covid/halsschmerzen-corona/)
  * Verstopfte oder laufende Nase
  * [Gliederschmerzen](https://ada.com/de/covid/gliederschmerzen-corona/)
  * Diarrhöe ([Durchfall](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-durchfall/))
  * Müdigkeit und Unwohlsein


Kopfschmerzen im Zusammenhang mit COVID-19 können in allen Altersgruppen[3](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
Wenn Du Dir unsicher bist, ob diese Beschwerden auf Dich zutreffen, starte eine 
## Was sind die Ursachen von Kopfschmerzen bei einer Coronavirus-Infektion?
Derzeit sind die Ursachen von Kopfschmerzen aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion[Symptome von COVID-19](https://ada.com/de/covid/) sind: [4](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") [5](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * Kopfschmerzen könnten durch bestimmte Botenstoffe (Zytokine) verursacht werden. Zytokine steuern die Reaktion des Körpers auf Infektionen, Entzündungen 
  * Eine weitere mögliche Ursache könnte die Aktivierung des trigeminovaskulären Systems sein. Dazu gehört unter anderem der Trigeminusnervs, der das GesichtGesichtsnerv
  * Coronaviren können auch die Lunge befallen und zu einem Sauerstoffmangel im Blut
  * Kopfschmerzen können auch durch eine Thrombose entstehen. Dabei handelt es sich um ein Blutgerinnsel


## Wie fühlen sich Kopfschmerzen aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion an?
Durch Coronaviren verursachte Kopfschmerzen können mäßig bis starkpochendenDruckgefühl[6](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
Der Ort der Kopfschmerzen im Zusammenhang mit COVID-19 kann unterschiedlich sein:
  * Auf beiden Kopfseiten oder
  * eher im vorderen Kopfbereich oder
  * im ganzen Kopf.
  * Zudem kannst Du die Kopfschmerzen hinter den Augen spüren. In manchen Fällen gehen Kopfschmerzen aufgrund einer [Coronavirus-Infektion mit Übelkeit und Erbrechen](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-uebelkeit-und-erbrechen/) einher. [6](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6") [7](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7") [8](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") [9](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") [10](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")


Die Kopfschmerzen können sich durch die folgenden Faktoren verschlimmern: [6](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6") [8](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8")
  * Körperliche Bewegung
  * Hustenanfälle
  * schrille Tönen oder helles Licht


## Wie lange dauern Kopfschmerzen aufgrund einer Coronavirus-Infektion?
In der Regel treten Kopfschmerzen aufgrund von Coronaviren direkt nach der Infektion mit dem Coronavirus und oft gleichzeitig mit anderen Symptomen auf. Sie können während der gesamten Erkrankungszeit bestehen bleiben. Meistens halten Kopfschmerzen bei COVID-19 nur einige Tage an[6](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
Die COVID-19-bedingten Kopfschmerzen treten meist plötzlich auf und verschlimmern sich im Laufe des Tages.[8](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8")
Einige Studienergebnisse deuten an, dass [COVID-19](https://ada.com/de/covid/) mit größerer Wahrscheinlichkeit kürzer dauert, wenn die Infizierten unter Kopfschmerzen leiden. [4](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
## Wie lassen sich Kopfschmerzen aufgrund von Coronaviren diagnostizieren?
Die Behandlung[11](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11") [12](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12") [13](https://ada.com/de/covid/corona-kopfschmerzen/#fn:13 "See Footnote 13")
  * Ausruhen
  * Wasser trinken
  * kalte Kompressen


Neben diesen Hausmitteln kannst Du auch rezeptfreie Schmerzmittel gegen COVID-19-bedingte Kopfschmerzen einnehmen:
  * Paracetamol
  * Ibuprofen
  * Aspirin


Abhängig vom Schweregrad Deiner Kopfschmerzen und weiterer Symptome, kann Dir Dein:e Ärzt:in auch andere Medikamente oder Behandlungen empfehlen.
Wenn Du Dir unsicher bist, ob diese Beschwerden auf Dich zutreffen, starte eine 
## Das Wichtigste auf einen Blick
Kopfschmerzen sind bei einer Coronavirus-Infektion häufig und können eines der ersten Symptome sein. Es sind aber nicht alle Menschen mit COVID-19 von Kopfschmerzen betroffen. Trotzdem ist es wichtig, auf dieses Symptom zu achten, insbesondere wenn es mit anderen Beschwerden einhergeht, da Kopfschmerzen ein Anhaltspunkt für den Schweregrad der Coronavirus-Infektion sein können. Falls Du neben anderen COVID-19-Symptomen auch Kopfschmerzen hast, solltest Du Dich in Quarantäne begeben und testen lassen.

Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
