# Infecção por influenza
Escrito pelo nosso [Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/pt/team/medical/)
Atualizado em 15 de fevereiro de 2022 às 10:01 GMT+2
## Nesta página
  * [Visão geral](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/influenza-infection/#visao-geral)
  * [Riscos](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/influenza-infection/#riscos)
  * [Sintomas](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/influenza-infection/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/influenza-infection/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamento](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/influenza-infection/#tratamento)
  * [Prevenção](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/influenza-infection/#prevencao)
  * [Prognóstico](https://ada.com/pt/conditions/influenza-infection/#prognostico)


* * *
Compartilhe esse artigo:
## Visão geral
Uma infecção por influenza, ou a gripe, é uma infecção viral comum das vias aéreas que ocorre com mais frequência no outono e inverno. O vírus da gripe se espalhada em gotículas da boca e nariz, que podem ser expelidas para o ar quando se espirra ou tosse, ou passado por louças e talheres. Pessoas com mais de 65 ou que tem outras condições médicas tendem a ficar gripados mais frequentemente, e correm o risco de desenvolver uma gripe severa. Essa condição causa febre, tosse, coriza, dores musculares e outras dores. Na maioria dos casos, não é necessário nenhum tratamento específico, e as pessoas melhoram em uma semana. Em casos raros, a gripe pode causar uma infecção grave, e esta condição pode se tornar fatal.
Você acha que pode estar enfrentando infecção por influenza
## Riscos
A gripe é causada por um vírus da influenza. O vírus provoca uma breve inflamação da garganta e do nariz. O vírus da gripe se espalha por gotículas da boca e nariz, que são expelidas ao ar quando a pessoa espirra ou tosse, ou é transmitido pelo uso comum de louças e talheres. A maioria das infecções ocorre nos meses de outono e inverno. Lactentes e indivíduos com mais de 65 anos tendem a ter a gripe mais comumente. As pessoas com um sistema imunológico enfraquecido ou que têm outras condições médicas de longo prazo também tem risco maior de contrair a gripe.
## Sintomas
Os sintomas típicos da gripe são febre, tosse, dor de garganta, pingo no nariz, dores musculares e articulares e uma sensação geral de mal estar. Os gânglios linfáticos na garganta pode estar maiores do que o normal. Os sintomas de uma infecção grave que pode necessitar de tratamento de emergência são falta de ar, chiado ao reespirar e dificuldades respiratórias.
## Diagnóstico
O diagnóstico se baseia geralmente nos sintomas e exame físico. Se o diagnóstico é incerto, ou os sintomas são graves, é recolhida uma amostra de muco da garganta ou do nariz e é testada para o vírus.
## Tratamento
Na maioria dos casos, não é necessário nenhum tratamento específico. As pessoas com gripe devem ficar em casa, não ir à escola ou ao trabalho, descansar e tomar bastante líquidos. Beber bebidas quentes ou chupar pastilhas para a garganta pode ajudar a aliviar uma dor de garganta. Tomar paracetamol ou ibuprofeno pode ajudar a aliviar a dor de cabeça e as dores musculares. Se o corrimento nasal for incômodo, pode ser útil usar um spray ou comprimidos de um descongestionante. Se a infecção for grave, existem medicamentos anti-virais para gripe, mas esses fazem pouca diferença para a recuperação em pessoas com sintomas leves ou moderados.
## Prevenção
Para evitar a propagação do vírus da gripe, é importante manter uma boa higiene quando se está doente, como por exemplo lavar as mãos regularmente e ficar em casa enquanto se está indisposto. A vacinação contra a gripe pode ajudar a prevenir a infecção em pessoas com alto risco de infecções graves, tais como os idosos e pessoas com outras condições médicas.
## Prognóstico
A maioria dos episódios de gripe melhoram após 5 a 7 dias e a maioria das pessoas se recupera completamente. Alguns sintomas como tosse e sensação de cansaço podem durar mais tempo, mas isso ´é normal. Pessoas com mais de 65 anos ou com condições médicas podem ter uma recuperação mais lenta e tem maior risco de complicações, incluindo infecções fatais.
## Saiba mais sobre seus sintomas

# Gehörgangsentzündung (Otitis externa)
Verfasst von [Adas medizinischem Fachpersonal](https://ada.com/de/team/medical/)
Aktualisiert am 22. Juli 2025 um 10:00 OESZ
## Auf dieser Seite

## Was ist eine Gehörgangsentzündung (Otitis externa)?
Die Otitis externa (Außenohrentzündung) ist eine Infektion des äußeren Gehörgangs und wird häufig auch als Schwimmbad-Otitis bezeichnet.[Diabetes](https://ada.com/de/conditions/diabetes-mellitus-type-2/) oder einem geschwächten Immunsystem das Risiko einer schweren Infektion besteht.
Andere Bezeichnung für Otitis externa: Infektion oder Entzündung des Gehörganges.
Finde mehr über Deine Symptome heraus.
## Gehörgangsentzündung: Ursachen und Risikofaktoren
Entzündungen des äußeren Ohres werden häufig von Bakterien oder Pilzen im äußeren Gehörgang verursacht. Dieser Gang verläuft zwischen dem Trommelfell und dem äußeren Ohr.
Eine Infektion tritt gewöhnlich auf, wenn der Gehörgang nass ist und Bakterien und Pilzen eine feuchte, warme Umgebung bietet, in der sie wachsen können.
Finde mehr über eine [Mittelohrentzündung](https://ada.com/de/conditions/acute-otitis-media/) heraus.
## Gehörgangsentzündung Symptome
Typische Symptome einer Infektion des äußeren Gehörgangs sind:
  * ein Juckreiz im Ohr,
  * Ohrenschmerzen,
  * Hörbeschwerden
  * und Ausfluss aus dem Ohr.


Manchmal kann das ganze äußere Ohr rot werden und anschwellen. In schweren Fällen können Menschen Kopfschmerzen und Fieber entwickeln. [1](https://ada.com/de/conditions/otitis-externa/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Wenn Du Dir unsicher bist, ob diese Beschwerden auf Dich zutreffen, starte eine 
## Diagnose
Die Diagnose erfolgt durch einen Arzt, basierend auf den Symptomen und einer körperlichen Untersuchung. Dabei wird ein kleines Gerät (Otoskop) verwendet, um den Gehörgang und das Trommelfell zu untersuchen.
## Was tun bei Gehörgangsentzündung?
Die Behandlung umfasst eine vorsichtige Reinigung des Ohrs, Schmerzmittel und eine Antibiotika-Therapie.[2](https://ada.com/de/conditions/otitis-externa/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
In seltenen Fällen können orale Antibiotika (in Form von Tabletten) erforderlich sein. Schwimmen, Fliegen und der Gebrauch von Ohrenstöpseln sollten vermieden werden, um eine weitere Reizung des Gehörgangs zu unterbinden.
## Prognose
Wird die Erkrankung korrekt behandelt, bessern sich die Symptome bereits innerhalb von ein bis zwei Tagen und verschwinden vollständig innerhalb von sieben bis zehn Tagen. Bei Betroffenen mit Diabetes oder mit einem geschwächten Immunsystem besteht das Risiko für schwere Infektionen, daher sollten sie ihren Arzt um Rat fragen.
## Vorsorge
Als Präventionsmaßnahmen können die Ohren beim Schwimmen trocken gehalten werden, indem weiche Ohrenstöpsel verwendet werden oder indem der Kopf oberhalb der Wasseroberfläche gehalten wird. Außerdem sollten keine Gegenstände in den Gehörgang eingeführt werden.

# Fehlgeburt
Verfasst von [Adas medizinischem Fachpersonal](https://ada.com/de/team/medical/)
Aktualisiert am 17. Juni 2025 um 14:14 OESZ
## Auf dieser Seite
  * [Was ist eine Fehlgeburt?](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#was-ist-eine-fehlgeburt)
  * [Risiken für eine Fehlgeburt](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#risiken-fuer-eine-fehlgeburt)
  * [Symptome](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#symptome)
  * [Diagnose](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#diagnose)
  * [Behandlung bei eingetretener Fehlgeburt](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#behandlung-bei-eingetretener-fehlgeburt)
  * [Prognose](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#prognose)
  * [Vorsorge](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#vorsorge)


* * *
Artikel teilen:
## Was ist eine Fehlgeburt?
Eine Fehlgeburt (Abort) ist eine vorzeitiger Abgang der Schwangerschaft vor der 20. Schwangerschaftswoche. Sie tritt am häufigsten innerhalb der ersten sieben Wochen einer Schwangerschaft auf.
Obwohl es viele mögliche Ursachen gibt, ist in vielen Fällen die genaue Ursache unbekannt. Das häufigste Symptom einer Fehlgeburt ist eine Blutung aus der Scheide, die mit krampfartigen Schmerzen im Unterbauch einhergehen kann. Die Diagnose erfolgt üblicherweise durch eine Reihe von Bluttests und eine Ultraschalluntersuchung. Einige Schwangere entscheiden sich dafür, die Fehlgeburt auf natürliche Weise ablaufen zu lassen, wohingegen andere eine medizinische Behandlung nach einer Fehlgeburt bevorzugen.
Emotionale Unterstützung für die Familie ist ein wichtiger Teil der Behandlung einer Fehlgeburt. Außerdem kann eine Beratung hilfreich sein. In vielen Fällen ist eine Fehlgeburt ein Einzelereignis und eine Frau, die sie erlitten hat, kann ohne Schwierigkeiten wieder schwanger werden.
Hast Du Beschwerden oder Symptome, die auf eine Fehlgeburt hinweisen könnten?
## Risiken für eine Fehlgeburt
Eine Fehlgeburt ist eine vorzeitige Beendigung der Schwangerschaft vor Ende der 20. Schwangerschaftswoche. Das Risiko für eine Fehlgeburt ist in den ersten sieben Schwangerschaftswochen am höchsten. Es gibt viele Gründe, die eine Fehlgeburt verursachen können, doch in vielen Fällen ist die genaue Ursache unbekannt. 1
Frauen im Alter von über 30 Jahren haben ein erhöhtes Risiko einer Fehlgeburt und das Risiko nimmt mit zunehmendem Alter weiter zu. Einige Krankheiten können mehrfache Fehlgeburten verursachen. Dies sind vor allem autoimmune (bei denen das Immunsystem das körpereigene Gewebe angreift) und hormonelle Erkrankungen.
Auch einige Infektionen können eine Fehlgeburt verursachen. Weitere Faktoren, die das Risiko einer Fehlgeburt erhöhen, sind unter anderem Drogen- und Alkoholkonsum während der Schwangerschaft, Fettleibigkeit und Rauchen.
## Fehlgeburt Symptome
Das häufigste Symptom einer Fehlgeburt ist eine Blutung aus der Scheide. Es kann zu Krämpfen und Schmerzen im unteren Bauch kommen und Klumpen und Flüssigkeit können aus der Scheide austreten. [2](https://ada.com/de/conditions/miscarriage/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
Wenn Du Dir unsicher bist, ob diese Beschwerden auf Dich zutreffen, starte eine 
## Diagnose
Die Diagnose einer Fehlgeburt erfolgt basierend auf den Symptomen und einer gynäkologischen Untersuchung, zusammen mit Bluttests und einer Ultraschalluntersuchung. Bluttests auf das Schwangerschaftshormon beta-hCG (humanes Choriongonadotropin) können über einen Zeitraum von einigen Tagen durchgeführt werden, um zu sehen, ob sich die Schwangerschaft fortsetzt. Der Wert dieses Hormons sinkt, wenn eine Fehlgeburt stattgefunden hat.
Eine Ultraschalluntersuchung der Gebärmutter kann durchgeführt werden, um zu sehen, ob es Anzeichen einer Schwangerschaft gibt. Dies kann jedoch in den ersten Schwangerschaftswochen unzuverlässig sein, sodass Bluttests tendenziell verlässlichere Informationen liefern. Wenn eine Frau bereits mehrere Fehlgeburten erlitten hat, können weitere Tests durchgeführt werde, um die zugrunde liegende Ursache herauszufinden.
## Behandlung bei eingetretener Fehlgeburt
Es gibt wenige Optionen für die Herangehensweise nach einer Fehlgeburt. Viele Betroffene entscheiden sich dafür, abzuwarten und einen natürlichen Ablauf der Fehlgeburt zu ermöglichen.
Ein weitere Ultraschalluntersuchung oder ein Bluttest wird durchgeführt, um zu sehen, ob eine weitere Behandlung erforderlich ist. Manche Frauen müssen Medikamente einnehmen oder einen chirurgischen Eingriff durchführen lassen, um das verbleibende Gewebe entfernen zu lassen.
Eine Fehlgeburt kann ein schwieriges Ereignis sein, weshalb eine gute emotionale Unterstützung und Beratung einigen Familien weiterhelfen kann.
## Prognose
Die meisten Fehlgeburten sind Einzelereignisse und die meisten Frauen können nach einer Fehlgeburt wieder schwanger werden.
## Vorsorge
In einigen Fällen kann eine Fehlgeburt nicht verhindert werden. Frauen, die an einer chronischen Krankheit leiden, sollten eine Schwangerschaft mit ihrem Arzt besprechen, ehe sie schwanger werden, um mögliche Maßnahmen zu ermitteln, die das Risiko einer Fehlgeburt verringern können.
Es gibt einige Erkrankungen, die bei einer Frau mehrfache Fehlgeburten verursachen können und Betroffene sollten daher auf diese untersucht und gegebenenfalls behandelt werden. Einige allgemeine Maßnahmen, die das Risiko einer Fehlgeburt verringern können, sind der Verzicht auf Alkohol und Tabak bereits vor der Schwangerschaft, die Auffrischung von Impfungen, die Behandlung von Infektionen und ein gesundes Körpergewicht.

# Acute HIV Infection
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)
Updated on April 17, 2025 at 1:00 PM GMT+2
## On this page
  * [What is acute HIV?](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#what-is-acute-hiv)
  * [Symptoms](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#symptoms)
  * [Duration](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#duration)
  * [How soon can HIV be detected by a blood test?](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#how-soon-can-hiv-be-detected-by-a-blood-test)
  * [HIV FAQs:](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#hiv-faqs)


* * *
Share this article:
Acute HIV is the first stage of HIV
Experiencing symptoms of HIV
This article focuses on acute HIV, which is the stage after the moment of infection where the virus first damages the immune system and multiplies rapidly. During this stage, people are highly infectious and should get tested as soon as possible. Treatment should be started right away for the best possible outlook. Usually, this condition progresses to chronic HIV and later on to AIDS.
## What is acute HIV?
An acute HIV infection is the first stage of an infection with the Human Immunodeficiency Virus
During the acute stage[the risk of transmission](https://ada.com/conditions/how-is-hiv-transmitted/) to other people will be high. This acute stage can go by unnoticed, as the symptoms could easily be mistaken for a cold, mononucleosis (mono) or the flu. There are also cases where people don’t show any symptoms at all.
The virus is dangerous as it targets CD4 cells. These are a type of white blood cells that fight infection. HIV destroys these cells and spreads throughout the body. Without treatment, the human immunodeficiency virus will destroy more and more CD4 cells and will multiply itself further. The acute infection can progress into a chronic HIV infection, which may then progress into AIDS. More information on this progression can be found on our specific page about [AIDS by clicking the link](https://ada.com/conditions/hiv-aids/). [1](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") [2](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
HIV is an STD, or [sexually transmitted disease](https://ada.com/sexual-health/). This means that you can get the virus through unprotected sex with an infected person. It can also be transmitted by sharing medical equipment like syringes. A mother can also pass the virus along to her child while giving birth or while breastfeeding. [3](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
## What are common symptoms of the acute stage of HIV?
Early stage HIV symptoms
  * Mouth ulcers
  * Red rash: an acute [hiv infection rash presents itself as an area of the skin that is irritated](https://ada.com/conditions/hiv-symptoms-rash/), itchy, painful and red. [4](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
  * Fever


Experiencing symptoms of HIV
Other symptoms[5](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [6](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
  * Aching muscles
  * Joint pains
  * Unintentional weight loss
  * Loss of coordination
  * Tiredness
  * Headache
  * Swollen lymph nodes (check [our article about HIV swollen lymph nodes](https://ada.com/conditions/hiv-swollen-lymph-node/))
  * [Sore throat](https://ada.com/conditions/hiv-symptoms-sore-throat/)
  * Diarrhea


HIV symptoms appear after 2 weeks in most cases. It’s important to know that these symptoms are also very common for other medical conditions and that some people may even have an acute HIV infection without any symptoms. It’s important to always know your HIV-status and to [get tested if you think you’re at risk](https://ada.com/sexual-health/at-home-hiv-test/) or if you participate in riskful behavior such as unprotected sex and sharing syringes.
## How long do HIV symptoms last?
The symptoms of an acute HIV infection can last anywhere from a few days to several weeks
The chronic infection can turn into AIDS after years of presence in the blood. It’s important to know that this progression can be slowed down or even prevented by early diagnosis and initiation of correct and early treatment. [6](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6") [7](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7")
## How soon can HIV be detected by a blood test?
As the infection can often be present without symptoms or with non-specific symptoms, it’s important to have bloodwork done if you think you could be at risk for an HIV-infection. An HIV test can come back positive from 10 to 90 days after a risk contact.
Acute HIV can be detected in various ways:
  1. A nucleic acid amplification test (NAAT)
  2. An antigen/antibody test
  3. An HIV antibody test


You should discuss your symptoms and possible risk factors with your doctor to find out which test is right for you. If you think that you’ve been exposed to HIV in the last 72 hours, you can talk to your doctor about taking PEP (post-exposure prophylaxis), which is an emergency medicine which you can take to [prevent an HIV infection](https://ada.com/editorial/how-to-prevent-sexually-transmitted-diseases/). If taken within 72 hours of exposure, PEP can be highly effective in preventing HIV. [8](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") [9](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") [10](https://ada.com/conditions/acute-hiv-infection/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")

  1. suspendarea imediată/temporară sau retragerea permanentă a dreptului de acces la platforma Ada,
  2. trimiterea unui avertisment,
  3. inițierea unei proceduri juridice împotriva dvs., inclusiv exercitarea dreptului de solicitare de rambursare a oricăror costuri și cheltuieli întâmpinate din cauza încălcării acordului (aceasta cuprinde, printre altele, costurile administrative corespunzătoare și cheltuielile de judecată), precum și
  4. dezvăluirea informațiilor către autoritățile de aplicare a legii, dacă și în măsura în care acest lucru este permis din punct de vedere legal și este considerat necesar.


7.4. Reacția la încălcarea acordului contractual de către dvs. nu este limitată la pașii prezentați la punctul 7.3 de mai sus. Avem dreptul de a iniția orice altă măsură, pe baza Termenilor și condițiilor și a prevederilor legale.
## 8. Terminarea raportului nostru contractual
8.1. În cazul în care, în orice moment, aveți impresia că nu mai puteți fi de acord cu acești Termeni și condiții sau cu Politica de confidențialitate, sunteți de acord să încetați imediat utilizarea platformei Ada.
8.2. Aveți oricând dreptul de a înceta utilizarea platformei Ada și de a rezilia contractul cu întreprinderea Ada, de exemplu în momentul în care nu sunteți de acord cu modificările propuse pentru platformă sau cu acești Termeni și condiții. Vă rugăm să urmați instrucțiunile prezentate pe platforma Ada pentru a vă dezactiva contul de utilizator. Dacă accesați platforma prin aplicația noastră Ada, vă puteți șterge contul de utilizator din meniu, la „Setări”.
8.3. Rezilierea contractului încheiat cu dvs. se va face cu un preaviz de două săptămâni.
8.4. Dreptul dvs. și al nostru de a rezilia acest contract din considerente importante rămâne neatins. Un considerent important reprezintă pentru noi, în special, dar nu exclusiv, încălcările dispozițiilor contractuale fundamentale (în special de la punctul 7.2) și dacă, din cauza unor circumstanțe exterioare, se poate deduce că folosiți în mod abuziv serviciile noastre. Dacă există un considerent important, suntem autorizați să vă blocăm drepturile de acces la platforma Ada, atât timp cât nu se poate lua o altă măsură punitivă mai ușoară.
8.5. Dacă dvs. sau noi dezactivăm contul dvs. de utilizator, așa cum este descris la acest punct, sau vă retragem dreptul de acces la platforma Ada, vom șterge datele cu caracter personal despre dvs., conform Politicii noastre de confidențialitate (și conform dispozițiilor legale aplicabile); iar drepturile noastre de utilizare a acestor date în formă anonimizată conform punctului 3.2 rămân neatinse. În plus, pierdeți prin aceasta dreptul acordat dvs. de acces la platforma noastră Ada.
## 9. Promisiunea noastră față de dvs.
9.1. Orice informații legate de simptomele introduse de dvs. care vă sunt puse la dispoziție în format text în sensul § 126b din Codul Civil German ca afirmație sau prin deducție, prin intermediul platformei Ada, servesc exclusiv unor scopuri informative. Informațiile sunt furnizate de întreprinderea Ada ca atare, fără garanție, asigurare sau confirmare de orice fel.
9.2. Nu ar trebui să luați nicio inițiativă pe baza informațiilor furnizate prin intermediul platformei Ada fără a apela mai întâi la un medic sau la personal medical specializat.
9.3. Având în vedere natura internetului și a tehnologiei, ne este imposibil să vă promitem că veți putea folosi platforma Ada oricând fără întreruperi și fără întârzieri sau erori și că platforma vă va îndeplini așteptările. Din acest motiv, nu ne putem asuma niciun fel de obligație referitoare la performanța sau disponibilitatea platformei Ada în acești Termeni și condiții. Excludem în mod expres și răspunderea față de posibilele deficiențe ale platformei Ada, care ar putea exista în momentul încheierii contractului în privința utilizării platformei Ada între dvs. și noi.
9.4. Dacă are loc vreo daună în timpul utilizării platformei, suntem răspunzători numai pentru daunele rezultate din intenție sau neglijență gravă. În plus, am putea fi considerați răspunzători pentru încălcare din neglijență a obligațiilor contractuale fundamentale, a căror îndeplinire singură permite executarea corespunzătoare a acestui contract, a căror încălcare aduce atingere scopului contractului și pentru respectarea cărora dvs., ca utilizator, aveți încredere că vor fi îndeplinite. În ultimul caz menționat, ne asumăm totuși răspunderea numai pentru daunele previzibile în mod obișnuit pentru contract. Nu ne asumăm răspunderea pentru încălcările din neglijență simplă altele decât obligațiile menționate în fragmentele de mai sus. Excluderile anterioare de răspundere nu se aplică încălcărilor cauzate de deces sau vătămare corporală și nici unei răspunderi în temeiul Legii germane privind răspunderea produsului.
## 10. Serviciile părților terțe
10.1. Dacă și în măsura în care platforma noastră cuprinde linkuri către alte site-uri web și resurse care sunt controlate de terți, aceste linkuri vă sunt puse la dispoziție cu scop pur informativ.
10.2. Ne este imposibil să influențăm conținutul acestor site-uri web sau resurse furnizate de terți și nu ne asumăm răspunderea pentru conținutul informațiilor sau site-urilor web interconectate sau incluse în cadre. Nu răspundem pentru eventualele daune financiare sau fizice pe care le-ați putea suferi, care au legătură cu folosirea acestor site-uri web sau resurse.
10.3. Sunteți de acord că disponibilitatea aplicației Ada depinde de acei terți de la care ați descărcat aplicația Ada (de ex. Apple App Store sau Google Play Store). Vă este cunoscut faptul că acești Termeni și condiții își găsesc aplicare în raportul contractual dintre dvs. și Ada, și nu în raportul contractual cu App Store.
## 11. Actualizările platformei Ada
11.1. Platforma Ada este supusă continuu actualizărilor și îmbunătățirilor. Ne străduim constant să vă oferim servicii și funcții noi și inovatoare. Îmbunătățirile și actualizările au la bază și tehnologiile în continuă schimbare, modurile diverse de comportament și modul în care folosesc oamenii internetul.
11.2. Ne rezervăm dreptul de a modifica o anumită parte a funcțiilor specifice platformei, actualizând platforma Ada, executând în acest sens o resetare și suspendând pentru aceasta serviciul sau asistența. Este posibil ca aceste modificări să influențeze activitățile dvs. în cadrul platformei Ada. Modificările cuprind, eventual, și ștergerea, modificarea sau resetarea funcțiilor folosite de dvs. Atât timp cât v-ați înregistrat, vă vom informa separat în legătură cu modificările și drepturile dvs. în cazul modificărilor (consultați punctul 12.3.).
11.3. Este posibil să apară din când în când actualizări de la noi sau de la App Store din care ați descărcat aplicația. Din când în când, poate fi necesar să trebuiască să actualizați software-ul terț pentru a putea folosi platforma.
## 12. Modificări ale Termenilor și condițiilor
12.1. Avem dreptul de a aduce din când în când modificări, ajustări sau completări acestor Termeni și condiții, iar noua versiune a Termenilor și condițiilor este disponibilă pe site-ul nostru web ([ada.com](https://ada.com/ro/terms-and-conditions/raw/)).
12.2. Posibilele modificări aduse acestor Termeni și condiții vor decurge în primul rând din noile funcții ale platformei Ada sau din modificările aduse legilor sau dispozițiilor aplicabile.
12.3. Vă vom contacta cu cel puțin 30 de zile calendaristice înainte de intrarea în vigoare a modificărilor sau completărilor aduse Termenilor și condițiilor, pentru a vă împărtăși aceste modificări sau completări. Dacă nu vă opuneți în termen de 30 de zile de la primirea notificării noastre prin email, modificările și completările vor fi considerate ca intrate în vigoare din momentul expirării timpului de răspuns. În notificarea noastră privind modificările la Termeni și condiții vă vom informa cu privire la dreptul dvs. la opoziție și urmările opoziției. Dacă, în cazul opoziției dvs. față de această modificare în timpul stabilit, este nerezonabil pentru noi din punct de vedere legal, economic sau tehnic să continuăm să vă punem la dispoziție platforma Ada, avem dreptul de a rezilia contractul cel mai devreme începând cu termenul menționat în notificare. Orice alt drept de reziliere rămâne neatins.
13. Documentele care stabilesc raportul contractual dintre dvs. și noi
Versiunea actuală a Termenilor și condițiilor cuprinde toate dispozițiile care stabilesc raportul contractual dintre dvs. și noi. Versiunile mai vechi ale Termenilor și condițiilor nu mai sunt valabile în ceea ce privește raportul nostru contractual și sunt înlocuite complet cu versiunea actuală.
## 14. Legislația aplicabilă și instanța competentă
14.1. Sediul nostru social se află în Germania. Contractul încheiat pe baza acestor Termeni și condiții se supune legislației Republicii Federale Germania. Fără a duce atingere legislației aplicabile, în cazul contractelor dintre întreprinderi cu consumatorii, se poate ajunge ca dispozițiile legislației țării în care consumatorul este rezident în mod obișnuit și de la care nu se poate face derogare, conform legislației acestei țări, să fie aplicate în beneficiul consumatorului în cazul în care întreprinderea
  1. își exercită activitatea profesională sau comercială în țara în care consumatorul își are reședința obișnuită sau
  2. își orientează activitatea, în orice fel, spre acea țară sau mai multe țări, printre care este inclusă și acea țară dintre care acea țară


iar contractul intră în incidența unei astfel de activități.
14.2. Instanțele germane au jurisdicție exclusivă pentru soluționarea oricăror conflicte care au legătură cu sau decurg din utilizarea platformei de către dvs.
14.3 Comisia Europeană furnizează o platformă online pentru soluționarea litigiilor, care este disponibilă pe 
## 15. Generalități
15.1. Sunteți de acord să vă contactăm pe cale electronică (de ex. prin email sau alte forme de text în sensul § 126b din Codul Civil German).
15.2. Vă putem trimite notificări prin emailul pe care ni l-ați indicat în momentul înregistrării pe platformă, sau prin intermediul unui alt serviciu electronic de comunicații din cadrul aplicației noastre Ada sau al site-ului web.
15.3. Neaplicarea drepturilor noastre nu poate fi considerată o renunțare la aceste drepturi.
15.4. Dacă o dispoziție a acestor Termeni și condiții este sau devine fără efect sau inaplicabilă, eficacitatea dispozițiilor rămase este neatinsă.
15.5. Numai partenerul contractual însuși are dreptul de a aplica dispoziții contractuale.

# Introducing AI4H – a WHO project to help unlock the full potential of AI in health
Shubs 
  * Published on November 8, 2019 
  * at 4:00am EDT 
  * · 4 min read 


At Ada, we believe that health AI will only achieve its full potential once it has gained the trust of clinicians, patients, and policymakers. We also believe that building – and earning – this trust is a challenge that can only be met collectively and collaboratively – no one AI company can do it alone; it will require the whole industry and all stakeholders to come together.
That is why we are taking part in an ambitious new global health initiative, 
Spearheaded by the World Health Organization (WHO) in partnership with the International Telecommunications Union (ITU), AI4H’s aim is to bring all stakeholders together to establish a clear method for standardized benchmarking of AI-powered solutions in healthcare so that anyone, anywhere, can have access to quality healthcare.
## Why benchmarking?
Benchmarking AI systems might seem like an unusual thing for the WHO to prioritize – but it is crucial for enabling a greater understanding of how these technologies can be deployed in the real world, while ensuring that companies are held to the highest medical and ethical standards. If we can establish this process for standardization on a global scale, we will be able to leverage emerging technologies as a lasting solution to global health issues, such as the shortage of global health workers – which is expected to reach 
Interestingly, as we’ve [previously explored](https://ada.com/editorial/the-challenges-of-benchmarking-digital-health/), effectively benchmarking AI in healthcare is often far from simple – particularly for symptom assessments, which is the area of health AI that Ada is focused on.
Why is it so challenging? Firstly, because healthcare and medicine are by their very nature incredibly complex. There are always multiple factors that must be taken into account within a clinical assessment or decision-making process, and finding a clear ‘ground truth’ is a real challenge. In addition, the information and guidance provided should be evaluated as a whole, and regional and demographic variation must be factored in.
## A cross-industry effort
The AI4H Focus Group is structured into 16 topic groups, with ours specifically focused on symptom assessment benchmarking. The topic group is made up of nine participating companies, with Ada taking the role as topic driver. This means we are responsible for pushing the conversation forward and striving for transparency, positive collaboration, and tangible results. In addition to the topic groups, there are also five horizontal working groups that independently advise the topic groups on overarching aspects like data and AI handling, health requirements, or regulatory considerations.
Our goal is to establish a pathway for globally consistent standardization across the sector. What does this mean in practice? It means that organizations such as the WHO, regulators, individual governments, and healthcare organizations will have an independent and reliable source of information about which AI technologies are appropriate for deployment, and in which contexts.
By paving the way for the safe and transparent adoption of these AI systems, we hope to dramatically improve access to healthcare for many people across the globe. This benchmarking initiative also marks an important step towards greater transparency and open dialogue around ethical assessment and impact, which we at Ada believe to be of critical importance in our industry.
## The state of play
We are currently one year into a two-year process that has the potential to provide the long-term foundations for regulators to build on in the future. The project has come a long way in a short space of time, and we’ve been hugely inspired and encouraged by the commitment and creativity that every participating organization has already shown. We spoke about some of our work at the World Health Summit in Berlin, and we were pleased to see this result in a number of positive discussions across the industry.
Our current research is focused on establishing a basic proof of concept for benchmarking on a technical level, and identifying the key obstacles for wider benchmarking protocols. Once this is done, we’ll be working together to find a non-biased, independent way of tackling those obstacles. Key considerations will include: ensuring objectivity and accurate global representation, discussing how test cases can be developed in a way that is independent and fair, and balancing the need to protect a company’s intellectual property with the broader need for transparency, to name just a few.
We are really excited to be driving the symptom assessment topic in the focus group, and over the coming weeks and months we will share more updates on the work the group is doing. We’ll soon be heading to New Delhi, India, for our next meeting in November, so you can expect to see some more developments soon. If you want to find out more, or if you have any questions for us, please do get in touch.
### Writer:
Dr. Shubhanan Upadhyay
Dr. Upadhyay is our Director of Medical Quality.

# Cáncer orofaríngeo
Escrito por nuestro [Equipo de Profesionales Médicos](https://ada.com/es/team/medical/)
Actualizado el 15 de febrero de 2022, 10:01 EET
## En esta página
  * [Resumen](https://ada.com/es/conditions/oropharyngeal-cancer/#resumen)
  * [Riesgos](https://ada.com/es/conditions/oropharyngeal-cancer/#riesgos)
  * [Síntomas](https://ada.com/es/conditions/oropharyngeal-cancer/#sintomas)

Comparte este artículo:
## Resumen
El cáncer orofaríngeo es un cáncer de la boca o la garganta. Afecta más a hombres que a mujeres y se diagnostica más comúnmente entre los 60 y 70 años de edad. Masticar o fumar tabaco, consumir alcohol y algunas infecciones aumentan el riesgo de contraer cáncer orofaríngeo. Los síntomas de este cáncer incluyen un cambio de la voz, dificultades para tragar, dolor de garganta persistente y una sensación de tener un bulto en la garganta. Se diagnostica tomando una muestra pequeña de tejido (biopsia) para determinar la presencia de cáncer. El tratamiento depende del tamaño del cáncer y de si se ha propagado al momento del diagnóstico. Suele incluir una combinación de cirugía, quimioterapia y radioterapia. El resultado del tratamiento tras un diagnóstico de cáncer orofaríngeo depende de la etapa del cáncer. Las personas cuyo cáncer deriva de una infección viral tienden a tener mejores probabilidades de recuperación.
## Riesgos
El cáncer se produce cuando un grupo de células anormales crecen descontroladamente. Estas células destruyen las células normales que las rodean y se pueden propagar a otras partes del cuerpo. El cáncer orofaríngeo aparece en la boca, la lengua o la garganta. Afecta más a hombres que a mujeres y se diagnostica más comúnmente entre los 60 y 70 años de edad. Las personas que fuman o mastican tabaco, consumen alcohol, tienen un sistema inmunitario debilitado o que recibieron radiación en el cuello tienen un riesgo más alto de desarrollar esta condición médica. También se sabe que algunas infecciones virales, más comúnmente el virus de las verrugas (virus del papiloma humano), aumentan el riesgo de que aparezca este cáncer.
## Síntomas
Los síntomas del cáncer orofaríngeo incluyen dificultad para tragar, dolor persistente de garganta u oído, tos, mal aliento, cambios de la voz, pérdida de peso sin explicación y una sensación de tener un bulto en la garganta. Es posible que exista un bulto que crece lentamente o una úlcera que no se cura.
## Diagnóstico
El diagnóstico se basa en los síntomas, un examen físico y el análisis de una muestra pequeña de tejido (biopsia) para detectar si existe cáncer. Es posible que sea necesario realizar otros estudios para determinar la etapa (estadio) del cáncer.
## Tratamiento
El tratamiento del cáncer orofaríngeo depende de su etapa al momento del diagnóstico. La decisión se basa en su tamaño, tipo exacto y si se ha propagado. El cáncer se puede tratar con quimioterapia, radioterapia, cirugía o una combinación de las tres. Una/un especialista en oncología es quien puede brindar el mejor asesoramiento sobre el tratamiento de los casos individuales.
## Prevención
Dejar de fumar y reducir el consumo de alcohol puede ayudar a prevenir algunos casos de cáncer orofaríngeo. Mantener relaciones sexuales con protección también puede ayudar a prevenir este cáncer.
## Pronóstico
El pronóstico depende del tipo de cáncer y de la etapa en que se lo haya diagnosticado. Las personas cuyo cáncer es causado por el virus de las verrugas (HPV, por sus siglas en inglés) tienen una mejor probabilidad de recuperación.

# Pneumothorax
Written by [Ada’s Medical Knowledge Team](https://ada.com/team/medical/)

## What is a pneumothorax?
A pneumothoraxreferred to as a collapsed lung or punctured lung[1](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
The lungs and the inside of the chest wall have a smooth lining known as the pleuraA pneumothorax occurs when air enters this space due to damage
This air buildup leads to increased pressure on the affected lung and prevents it from being able to expand fully. [3](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
A pneumothorax usually occurs on one side of the chest
Signs of a pneumothorax vary depending on the amount of lung area affectedi.e.[1](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") They include a sudden, sharp chest pain, followed by shortness of breath, which may also be severe. An X-ray may be used to confirm the diagnosis
Think you might be experiencing symptoms of pneumothorax
A pneumothorax can sometimes occur without any particular cause. In such cases, it is called a spontaneous pneumothorax. This occurs especially often in young, lean, and tall men and is much more likely in heavy smokers[1](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1") Other pneumothorax causes include injury to the chest, lung disease, being on a breathing machine, surgery to the chest or abdomen, or a blocked airway. [4](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4")
A small pneumothorax may occasionally not need any particular treatment, but a larger pneumothorax may need to have the air let out to help improve breathing and to allow the lung to expand again. This condition can lead to problems that may be life-threatening. However, with proper treatment, most people recover from a pneumothorax without any substantial long-term problems.
## Pneumothorax symptoms
The most commonpneumothorax symptoms[5](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [6](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
  1. A sudden, sharp stabbing pain on one side of the chest, usually made worse by breathing in
  2. Shortness of breath


Additional symptoms[5](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [6](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
  * A feeling of tightness in the chest
  * A rapid heart rate
  * Rapid breathing
  * Feeling physically weak
  * Anxiety
  * Confusion
  * Blue fingers and lips
  * Possibly collapse


Other symptoms may be present if a lung infection is the cause. These may include: [5](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
  * A cough
  * A high temperature or fever


Good to know:more severe symptoms of a pneumothorax, such as substantial shortness of breath, require emergency treatment in a hospital, and the person affected should be transported to a hospital in the quickest possible way, e.g. in an ambulance.
Feeling unwell? Get a symptom assessment with the symptom checker works before you try it for yourself.
## What causes a pneumothorax?
A pneumothorax is the presence of air between the two thin layers of membrane, known as the pleura, that cover the lungs and also line the inside of the chest wall
Normally, the pressure in the pleural space is lower than that of the atmosphere or inside the lungs. If there is a cut or tear that makes a connection between the pleural space and the inside of the lungs or the atmosphere, then air will enter the pleural space. This continues until the pressure equalizes or the connection closes. Air in the pleural space causes the lung to collapse partially or fully, leading to this lung or part of the lung being non-functional, causing shortness of breath.
Pneumothorax causes[7](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7") [8](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8")
  * An injury to the chest, which could be from blunt force or from something penetrating the chest
  * An underlying lung condition or lung infection
  * An invasive medical procedure on the chest or abdomen
  * Being on a breathing machine/ventilator due to treatment in hospital or a long-term care facility


Good to know:
## Types of pneumothorax
There are two main types
1. Traumatic pneumothorax:[9](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9")
Good to know:
2. Spontaneous pneumothorax:
### These two main types of pneumothorax may be further divided into four categories:
#### 1. Primary spontaneous pneumothorax (PSP)
This is the most common type of spontaneous pneumothorax. It develops for no clear reason in an otherwise healthy person.
Risk factors for a primary spontaneous pneumothorax include: [10](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10") [11](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:11 "See Footnote 11")
  * Being tall and thin,
  * Gender:
  * Age:
  * Family history
  * Smoking tobacco
  * A previous pneumothorax
  * Women with thoracic endometriosis,
  * Certain rare genetic conditions,


#### 2. Secondary spontaneous pneumothorax (SSP)
This develops as a complication of an existing lung disease,
Symptoms are normally more severe
Risk factors for a secondary spontaneous pneumothorax include: [5](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [12](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12")
  * Emphysema
  * Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
  * [Asthma](https://ada.com/conditions/asthma/)
  * [Pneumonia](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumonia/)
  * [Tuberculosis](https://ada.com/conditions/tuberculosis/)
  * Sarcoidosis, a rare condition that causes small patches of red and swollen tissue, usually in the lungs and skin
  * Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a condition in which tissues in the lung become thick and scarred over time
  * [Cystic fibrosis](https://ada.com/conditions/cystic-fibrosis/)
  * Lung cancer


#### 3. Closed traumatic pneumothorax
Closed pneumothorax is caused by blunt trauma,[13](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:13 "See Footnote 13")
#### 4. Open traumatic pneumothorax
Open pneumothorax, also known as a sucking chest wound, may occur after a penetrative injury,
This causes air to flow into the lungs through the normal breathing mechanism and simultaneously into the pleural space through the opening in the chest wall. This open pneumothorax may then lead to collapse of the affected side of the lung, with ventilation being practically eliminated on the affected side. [14](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:14 "See Footnote 14")
Good to know:occurs as a complication of medical or surgical procedures
Some cases of iatrogenic pneumothorax are not very serious and do not require treatment, while others can lead to serious cases that may require emergency treatment.
Think you might be experiencing symptoms of pneumothorax
## Complications of pneumothorax
In many cases, a pneumothorax responds well to treatment or may even resolve on its own, healing from within a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on the cause and the severity of the pneumothorax. In some cases, more serious complications can occur.
### Tension pneumothorax
In most cases of pneumothorax, some air can move in and out through the tear in the lung or chest wall. In some cases, more likely when a person is affected by open pneumothorax from penetrating chest injuries – though this is also possible in other forms of pneumothorax – air can move into the chest cavity, but not out, leading to a buildup of pressure inside the pocket of trapped air.
This can lead to compression of the neighboring lung and even push the heart and major blood vessels to the other side of the chest, which may lead to cardiac failure. A tension pneumothorax is a life-threatening emergency. If suspected, medical attention should be sought immediately, and the person affected should be transported to a hospital in the quickest possible way, e.g. in an ambulance.
The classic signs of a tension pneumothorax include: [16](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:16 "See Footnote 16")
  * Chest pain
  * Rapid heart rate
  * Low blood pressure
  * Rapid, distressed breathing
  * Severe difficulty breathing
  * An overly expanded chest that moves very little with breathing


The risk of tension pneumothorax is increased in the case of: [18](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:18 "See Footnote 18") [19](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:19 "See Footnote 19")
  * Secondary spontaneous pneumothorax,
  * People who are on artificial/mechanical ventilation,
  * Pneumothorax as a result of trauma,
  * People who have been resuscitated
  * Blocked, clamped or displaced chest drains,
  * People undergoing hyperbaric oxygen therapy,


### Recurrent pneumothorax
Some people who have had one pneumothorax may have another, usually within one to two years of the first. Causes of recurrent pneumothorax may include: [20](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:20 "See Footnote 20")
  * Rupture of further blebs
  * Continued air leakage on the site of a previous pneumothorax


To reduce the possibility of blebs and recurrence of pneumothorax a person may: [21](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:21 "See Footnote 21")
  * Stop smoking tobacco products,
  * Avoid air travel,
  * Avoid diving,


Think you might be experiencing symptoms of pneumothorax?
[Check your symptoms with Ada](https://ada.com/symptom-assessment/?mtm_source=web_articles&mtm_medium=organic&mtm_campaign=;geo:us;lan:en;cli:ada;prdcat:hejo_ga;prd:ada;campff:pneumothorax&mtm_content=;contff:conditions)
## Diagnosis
A doctor may suspect a pneumothorax if a person suddenly develops shortness of breath or chest pain, especially after trauma to the chest. They may ask about the affected person’s medical history, including any previous or current smoking habits, and they may carry out a physical examination. Tests to confirm diagnosis may include:[19](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:19 "See Footnote 19") [22](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:22 "See Footnote 22")
### 1. Pneumothorax X-ray
A chest X-ray (CXR) is often the best and quickest way to confirm the presence of a pneumothorax, which will appear on the X-ray as a darker area on the chest, representing the additional air in the chest cavity.
### 2. Pneumothorax computed tomography (CT) scan
In cases where there is doubt about the location or presence of a pneumothorax or for people with extensive lung disease, a CT scan may be used to find a small collapsed area of a lung.
### 3. Pulse oximeter or blood test
A doctor may also measure the oxygen level in the blood with a handheld device called a pulse oximeter, or they may draw blood from the wrist to directly measure the oxygen and carbon dioxide levels in the arterial blood, i.e. blood that has just passed through the lungs. While this alone does not normally allow for a diagnosis, it helps to determine how severely affected the person is and may help in determining treatment options.
If you are worried that you or someone you know may have this condition, use the symptom checker works.
## Pneumothorax treatment
Pneumothorax treatment depends on the size of the air collection in the chest and the severity of the symptoms. A small pneumothorax may not require any particular treatment, as it may resolve on its own.
People with more severe symptoms need emergency treatment[5](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [23](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:23 "See Footnote 23")
### Pneumothorax chest tube
If the affected person is breathless, due to a larger pneumothorax or other lung or breathing problems, then the trapped air may need to be removed
This involves putting in a chest tube, inserted with the aid of a needle,
In the case of tension pneumothorax, decompression is done as a matter of urgency.Some cases of pneumothorax may need to be treated by a tube remaining in place for a few days and applying continued suction, for example if there are frequent recurrences within a short time.
### Pneumothorax surgery
Sometimes pneumothorax happens again spontaneously. A person who has had repeated episodes of pneumothorax may be recommended surgery to prevent the condition from coming back again. It may also be recommended to anyone who has had a tension pneumothorax. [23](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:23 "See Footnote 23")
A lung specialist will be able to advise on the pros and cons of each procedure, according to each individual case of a pneumothorax. Pneumothorax surgery may include:
#### Pleurodesis
This is an operation to help stick the two membranes, known as pleura, that surround the lung back together.
  * Under local anesthetic,
  * Undergeneral anesthesia,


Pleural abrasion is a type of pleurodesis that works by irritating the lung surface.[23](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:23 "See Footnote 23")
  * Chemical pleurodesis using an irritant powder, such as talc
  * Rubbing with a rough pad, causing inflammation which makes the lung surface stick to the inside of the chest wall


#### Pleurectomy
This is the removal of part of the pleura that surrounds the lung and lines the inner chest cavity, so that the lung sticks to the inside of the chest wall. It may also be combined with the other methods mentioned here. 
#### Bullectomy
This is the removal of blebs or bullae, weakened sac-like areas on the lung surface that are more likely to rupture.
## Pneumothorax recovery time
A very small pneumothorax in a healthy adult may heal within a few days without treatment. Otherwise, recovery generally takes from one to a few weeks.
Good to know:
Measures to aid recovery time include: 
  * Avoiding smoking tobacco
  * Resting
  * Avoiding talking loudly and laughing
  * Breathing exercises if recommended by a doctor
  * Taking a cough suppressant if recommended by a doctor


## Pneumothorax in newborns
Rarely, pneumothorax can occur in newborn babies when some of the tiny air sacs, known as alveoli, in a baby’s lung become overinflated and burst.
Causes of neonatal pneumothorax include: [27](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:27 "See Footnote 27") [28](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:28 "See Footnote 28")
Respiratory distress syndrome (RDS)[29](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:29 "See Footnote 29")
Good to know:
Meconium aspiration syndrome
The use of continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP), a technique that allows newborns to breathe on their own while receiving slightly pressurized oxygen, or a breathing machine[30](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:30 "See Footnote 30")
Rarely, other conditions that affect the lungs, such as [pediatric pneumonia](https://ada.com/conditions/pediatric-pneumonia/) may also lead to neonatal pneumothorax.
Very rarely, even an otherwise healthy infant can develop a pneumothorax when he or she takes the first few breaths after birth, as the pressure needed to expand the lungs for the first time may in very rare cases be enough to cause a rupture. [27](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:27 "See Footnote 27")
Symptoms of pneumothorax in a newborn may include: [27](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:27 "See Footnote 27") [28](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:28 "See Footnote 28")
  * Fast breathing and grunting
  * Nostril flaring
  * Indrawing of the skin in between each rib and indrawing of the stomach just below the rib cage
  * Chest appears markedly larger on one side than on the other
  * Low oxygen saturation of the blood resulting in bluish skin color
  * Irritability/excessive crying or crying that is different from usual
  * Restlessness
  * Difficulty feeding the baby


Neonatal pneumothorax may get better on its own, without treatment. Larger air leaks may require treatment, which can include: [28](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:28 "See Footnote 28") [30](https://ada.com/conditions/pneumothorax/#fn:30 "See Footnote 30")
Supplementing oxygen:
Draining collected air with a syringe or a chest tube:
If the pneumothorax is an isolated event and is treated quickly, the prognosis or outcome is normally good. Long-term lung damage is rare. If other trauma was sustained at the same time or tension pneumothorax occurred with subsequent shock and inadequate blood flow to the body tissues, the prognosis may worsen. An affected infant will most likely also need regular follow-up clinic appointments. It is important to adhere closely to the doctor’s recommendations during the stay and when discharged from the hospital. 
## Other names sometimes used for pneumothorax
  * Collapsed lung
  * Punctured lung

## What is adjustment disorder?
Adjustment disorder is sometimes referred to as situational depressionabnormal emotional and/or behavioral response to stressors which are present in a particular period of a person’s life,
For example, a person may experience stressors that give rise to adjustment disorder
Symptoms of adjustment disorder or situational depression include:
  * Psychological symptoms associated with depression,
  * Psychological symptoms associated with anxiety,


These symptoms will normally begin within three months of the onset of the stressor; for example, after moving home; and last for no longer than six months after the stressor or event has ended.[1](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Adjustment disorder is most common in children and adolescents, but adults may often also develop the condition. The treatment goal for adjustment disorder is to relieve the symptoms. A typical treatment programme for adjustment disorder will normally feature a course of talking therapy, such as cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) or group therapy and may include prescription medications and prescribed exercise. [2](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2") [3](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:3 "See Footnote 3")
## Symptoms of adjustment disorder
The symptoms of adjustment disorder will usually appear within three months of the stressful event or life change and disappear within six months. Most commonly, adjustment disorder which does not resolve after six months may develop
Generally, the symptoms of adjustment disorder will significantly interfere with the functioning of a person's life, for example by making it difficult to socialize, work or attend school.
Symptoms of adjustment disorder may vary according to the age of the person experiencing the condition. Children and adolescents may be more likely to display behavioral symptoms, such as acting out, school problems and sleep disturbances, whereas adults often tend to experience more emotional symptoms, such as anxiety and a depressed mood. [4](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:4 "See Footnote 4") [5](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5")
## Symptoms of different adjustment disorder types
6 subtypes of adjustment disorder can be found according to the fifth edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders by the American Psychiatric Association (DSM-5). [5](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:5 "See Footnote 5") [6](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:6 "See Footnote 6")
### Adjustment disorder with depressed mood
Symptoms of adjustment disorder with depressed mood may include feelings of depression, sadness and hopelessness. People who are affected may also be highly tearful and experience frequent bouts of crying.
### Adjustment disorder with anxiety
Symptoms of adjustment disorder with anxiety may include feelings of nervousness, apprehension and worry. People may also be excessively jittery and fearful of separation, from parents or other significant people.
### Adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood
A person who is affected by adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood will experience a mixture of the symptoms of adjustment disorder with anxiety and those of adjustment disorder with depressed mood. People with this form of the condition may be affected by different symptoms or combinations of symptoms.
### Adjustment disorder with disturbance of conduct
A person who is affected by adjustment disorder with disturbance of conduct will experience a change in behavior
  * A lack of respect for the rights and feelings of others
  * A lack of respect for social norms and rules


### Adjustment disorder with mixed disturbance of emotions and conduct
A person affected by adjustment disorder with mixed disturbance of emotions and conduct may experience a combination of the possible symptoms of adjustment disorder with depressed mood, anxiety or disturbance of conduct.
### Adjustment disorder unspecified
In the case of adjustment disorder unspecified, a person experiences a severe reaction to a stressor, but it does not fit into any of the above categories.
## Causes of adjustment disorder
Adjustment disorder is a reaction to a particular stressor, whether a stressful life event or a major life change. In both children and adults, adjustment disorder can be caused by any event which feels greatly significant to the particular person,[7](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:7 "See Footnote 7")
Common stressors that may lead to adjustment disorder in a person of any age include: [8](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8")
  * Giving birth
  * Marriage
  * Unemployment
  * Retirement
  * Divorce or relationship problems
  * Illness and health issues
  * Moving to a new house or new location
  * Financial difficulties
  * The death of a loved one


Common stressors that may affect a child or young adult include:
  * Parental divorce or separation
  * Moving to a new house, neighborhood or new town
  * Problems at school, such as not being able to keep up with demands from school, changing schools or not being able to connect with peers
  * Health issues and/or sexuality issues, i.e. uncertainties related to sexual orientation
  * Death of a close relative or friend


## Adjustment disorder risk factors
There is no clear way to identify why some people develop adjustment disorder in response to a given stressor and why others do not. Factors, such as a person’s coping skills, past experiences and social skills are among many others, all thought to play a role.
A person is at greater risk of experiencing adjustment disorder than the general population if they meet any one or more of the following criteria: [9](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:9 "See Footnote 9") [8](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8")
  * Being female
  * Being affected by other psychological conditions
  * Experiencing long-term stressors
  * Lacking a social support system
  * Having experienced certain types of stress during childhood
  * Being single
  * Being at a low educational level
  * Living in an urban area


## Diagnosing adjustment disorder
A diagnosis of adjustment disorder usually requires a full psychological evaluation by a psychiatrist or other mental health professional. This evaluation will typically take into account past experiences, behaviors, emotions and sources of stress, among other factors. When diagnosing children or adolescents, parents may also be present during the evaluation. [10](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:10 "See Footnote 10")
The key diagnostic criteria for adjustment disorder are:
  * The symptoms must have begun to appear within three months
  * The condition must be characterized by stress
  * The symptoms must be distinct from similar disorders,


### Differential diagnosis: adjustment disorder vs. post traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
Although adjustment disorder and [post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)](https://ada.com/conditions/post-traumatic-stress-disorder/) can have overlapping symptoms, the key difference between the two conditions is their cause. Adjustment disorder is typically triggered by a stressful event or phase, but one that is within the normal everyday range of human experience, such as a marriage breakup or financial difficulty.
Conversely, PTSD is caused by an exceptional, traumatic event. This is normally one involving the threat of death, serious injury or violence to oneself, or an event which involves witnessing the same happening to a very close or loved person. Experiencing this severe threat causes retrospective feelings of extreme fear, horror and helplessness.
PTSD can also be a long-term condition that may not present itself until several months or years after the initial event. Adjustment disorder, on the other hand, must present itself within three months of the triggering event.
### Differential diagnosis: adjustment disorder vs. depression
Adjustment disorder – especially the depressed mood subtype – and [depression](https://ada.com/conditions/depressive-episode/) are similar conditions. To properly differentiate them, a thorough evaluation by a medical professional is needed.
One major, generally accepted difference between the two conditions is that adjustment disorder is triggered by an identifiable stressful event or phase,
Good to know:six months[12](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:12 "See Footnote 12")

## Treating adjustment disorder
The chosen treatment method for adjustment disorder will usually depend on a variety of factors, including: [13](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:13 "See Footnote 13")
  * Age
  * Severity of symptoms
  * The subtype being experienced
  * Specific factors contributing to the development or worsening of the condition


Taking these factors into consideration, a psychiatrist or other mental health professional will recommend a treatment route. [14](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:14 "See Footnote 14") [15](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:15 "See Footnote 15")
### Individual psychotherapy
Individual psychotherapy may take a cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) approach, particularly in the U.K., buy in the U.S., other kinds of talk therapy may often be recommended, too. Because the condition is defined as short-term, this will typically be solution-focussed, short course of psychotherapy. The treatment goal is to equip the affected person to understand how to overcome adjustment disorder by teaching them techniques for dealing more effectively with their particular problem and its effects on their life.
### Family therapy
Family therapy will generally be recommended in cases of childhood or adolescent adjustment disorder. It is designed to overcome conflicts in family life and improve communication skills among family members. It may also be useful in teaching family members how to support the child/adolescent who is experiencing adjustment disorder.
### Group therapy
In some cases, sharing challenge and coping techniques with a group of people also experiencing the condition can equip a person to understand how to overcome adjustment disorder in a practical sense and to apply this to their own life. Group therapy can also help the person improve their communication skills and can be a useful source of support and encouragement. [16](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:16 "See Footnote 16")
### Medication
Although supportive, solution-oriented psychotherapy is the first-line treatment for adjustment disorder, medications are sometimes additionally prescribed. [17](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:17 "See Footnote 17")
When medications are prescribed, they are used in order to treat specific symptoms[8](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") It is for this reason that medications are usually only prescribed in severe cases, are carefully evaluated by a person’s medical care team and are most likely an adjunct to rather than a replacement for talk therapy, which targets the condition’s root cause. [18](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:18 "See Footnote 18")
Medications which may be used in the treatment of adjustment disorder include: [8](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:8 "See Footnote 8") [17](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:17 "See Footnote 17") [18](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:18 "See Footnote 18")
  * Antidepressants.
  * Benzodiazepines.


Good to know:Always consult a doctor before using any type of herbal preparation, as they may not be safe for particular people or in combination with certain medications.[17](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:17 "See Footnote 17")
## Preventing adjustment disorder
There is no known way to prevent the onset of adjustment disorder. Identifying the condition early and seeking professional help can be effective in reducing the severity of adjustment disorder and improving general wellbeing, however.
## Find out more about your symptoms
## Adjustment disorder FAQs
Q: What happens if adjustment disorder lasts longer than six months?  
A:[19](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:19 "See Footnote 19") While this is the time frame referred to in most diagnostic manuals, others accept that some of the symptoms may persist longer, especially if the condition is caused by an ongoing stressor. Therefore, it is important to note that a person may be affected by the condition for longer than the usual time frame if the causal stressor is chronic, i.e. has long-term consequences or is itself long-lasting, for example unemployment or a severe, long lasting medical condition. [20](https://ada.com/conditions/adjustment-disorder/#fn:20 "See Footnote 20") Adjustment disorder which is longer-lasting than usual is sometimes referred to as chronic adjustment disorder.

# Infarto del tronco encefálico
Escrito por nuestro [Equipo de Profesionales Médicos](https://ada.com/es/team/medical/)
Actualizado el 25 de enero de 2022, 12:33 EET
## En esta página
  * [Resumen](https://ada.com/es/conditions/brain-stem-stroke/#resumen)
  * [Riesgos](https://ada.com/es/conditions/brain-stem-stroke/#riesgos)
  * [Síntomas](https://ada.com/es/conditions/brain-stem-stroke/#sintomas)
  * [Diagnóstico](https://ada.com/es/conditions/brain-stem-stroke/#diagnostico)
  * [Tratamiento](https://ada.com/es/conditions/brain-stem-stroke/#tratamiento)
  * [Prevención](https://ada.com/es/conditions/brain-stem-stroke/#prevencion)
  * [Pronóstico](https://ada.com/es/conditions/brain-stem-stroke/#pronostico)


* * *
Comparte este artículo:
## Resumen
Un infarto del tronco encefálico es un tipo de accidente cerebrovascular arterial altaniveles altos de colesterolenfermedades cardiovasculares
¿Te sientes mal? Revisa tus síntomas con la app verificador de síntomas antes de probar nuestra app.
## Riesgos
Los infartos del tronco encefálico se producen por una interrupción del suministro de sangre al tronco encefálico, ya sea por un bloqueo en los vasos sanguíneos (accidente cerebrovascular isquémico) o por un sangrado en el tronco encefálico (accidente cerebrovascular hemorrágico). Es más frecuente en los hombres y se torna más común con el paso de los años. Las personas con fibrilación auricular (un ritmo cardíaco anormal), presión arterial alta, colesterol alto, enfermedades cardiovasculares y antecedentes familiares de infartos o mini infartos cerebrales tienen mayor riesgo. Fumar, abusar del alcohol y la falta de actividad física también aumentan el riesgo de presentar esta condición.
## Síntomas
Los síntomas pueden variar mucho de persona a persona
## Diagnóstico
El diagnóstico suele realizarse en una consulta de neurología
## Tratamiento
Ante un posible infarto del tronco encefálico es necesaria una consulta médica urgente. El tratamiento depende del tipo de infarto y de los síntomas. Si una hemorragia causó el ataque, es posible que sea necesario detenerla usando una grapa (clip) o un espiral. Si un bloqueo en un vaso sanguíneo causó el accidente cerebrovascular, se puede disolver con la ayuda de medicación. El tratamiento a largo plazo depende de las consecuencias del ataque, pero la fisioterapia y la fonoaudiología (logopedia) son útiles. Es posible que algunas personas necesiten tomar medicamentos para diluir la sangre (anticoagulantes) para prevenir otro ataque.
## Prevención
El ejercicio regular, perder peso, dejar de fumar y evitar el abuso de alcohol o drogas son medidas que pueden ayudar a reducir la probabilidad de tener un accidente cerebrovascular. La presión arterial alta, la fibrilación auricular y la diabetes se deben controlar bien con el fin de reducir el riesgo de tener un accidente cerebrovascular.
## Pronóstico
Las consecuencias de un infarto del tronco encefálico dependen del tamaño del infarto y de la zona del cerebro afectada. En algunos casos, puede poner en riesgo la vida. El diagnóstico y tratamiento tempranos mejoran las probabilidades de recuperación, pero en algunos casos esta condición trae complicaciones graves a largo plazo.
## Aprende más acerca de tus síntomas

# Bakterielle Vaginose
Verfasst von [Adas medizinischem Fachpersonal](https://ada.com/de/team/medical/)
Aktualisiert am 15. März 2022 um 18:17 OEZ
## Auf dieser Seite
  * [Was ist bakterielle Vaginose?](https://ada.com/de/conditions/bacterial-vaginosis/#was-ist-bakterielle-vaginose)

Artikel teilen:
Dieser Artikel enthält Informationen zur Selbstbehandlung der Erkrankung. Für weitere Fragen oder Rat zur Behandlung, wende Dich an eine:n Ärzt:in.
## Was ist bakterielle Vaginose?
Eine bakterielle Vaginitis, auch bakterielle Vaginose genannt, ist eine durch Bakterien verursachte Infektion der Scheide. Sie wird durch ein Ungleichgewicht oder durch ein Überwachstum der natürlichen Bakterien der Scheide verursacht.
Diese Erkrankung tritt bei sexuell aktiven Frauen häufiger auf. Das häufigste Symptom ist ein grauer, schaumiger und unangenehm riechender Scheidenausfluss. Die kurzzeitige Behandlung mit Antibiotika kann diese Erkrankung heilen. Die meisten Betroffenen haben keine dauerhaften Beschwerden.
Andere Bezeichnung für bakterielle Vaginose: Bakterielle Infektion in der Scheide.
Hast Du oder eine andere Person Symptome, die auf diese Erkrankung hinweisen könnten? Starte jetzt eine kostenlose Symptomanalyse mit der [Adas Symptom-Checker](https://ada.com/de/app/) funktioniert.
## Risiken für eine bakterielle Vaginose
Eine bakterielle Vaginitis kann auftreten, wenn die natürliche bakterielle Besiedlung in der Scheide aus dem Gleichgewicht gerät. Die Nutzung eines Intrauterinpessars (Spirale), die Einnahme von Antibiotika sowie die Durchführung von Scheidenspülungen kann dazu beitragen.
## Symptome einer bakteriellen Vaginose
Das häufigste Symptom ist ein grauer, schaumiger und unangenehm riechender Scheidenausfluss.
Manche Frauen klagen außerdem über einen Juckreiz und das Anschwellen der äußeren Geschlechtsorgane
## Diagnose
Die Diagnose wird normalerweise basierend auf den Symptomen, einer gynäkologischen Untersuchung und in manchen Fällen durch das Untersuchen einer Probe des Scheidenausflusses auf ungewöhnliche Bakterien erstellt.
## Behandlung der bakteriellen Vaginose
Zur Behandlung werden kurzzeitig Antibiotika in Form von Tabletten eingenommen. Es gibt auch Antibiotika in Form eines Gels, das in die Scheide eingeführt werden kann.
## Prognose
Diese Erkrankung ist normalerweise unkompliziert und klingt nach einer Behandlung mit Antibiotika ab.
## Vorsorge
Das Vermeiden von Scheidenspülungen, Parfüms oder Deodorants für den Intimbereich kann bei manchen Frauen dabei helfen, der Entwicklung einer bakteriellen Vaginitis vorzubeugen.
## Finde mehr über Deine Symptome heraus

# You don't have any ads in the app. How do you make money?
We believe that everyone should have access to quality, personalized health information and care, which is why Ada’s assessment technology is free to anyone with a smartphone. We partner with government institutions, companies and other industry stakeholders and have received grants such as the EU's Horizon 2020 Programme. 
No personal or health data has been sold to third parties or shared for any commercial purpose. [Ada does not share your data with anyone unless you explicitly tell us to do so.](https://ada.com/help/360000751440/) We are funded through private investment, as well as commercial relationships with several health systems, insurers, and life science companies to provide services for their users. Ada also receives funding from charitable foundations (including The Rockefeller Foundation; The Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation; Fondation Botnar) to improve access to care, practitioner quality and universal coverage in low and middle-income countries. # Röteln (Rubella)
Verfasst von [Adas medizinischem Fachpersonal](https://ada.com/de/team/medical/)
Aktualisiert am 26. Februar 2025 um 10:45 OEZ
## Auf dieser Seite
  * [Was ist Röteln (Rubella)?](https://ada.com/de/conditions/rubella/#was-ist-roeteln-rubella)
  * [Risiken](https://ada.com/de/conditions/rubella/#risiken)

  * [Prognose](https://ada.com/de/conditions/rubella/#prognose)

* * *
Artikel teilen:
## Was ist Röteln (Rubella)?
Röteln - auch als Rubella bekannt - sind eine Virusinfektion, die am häufigsten bei Kindern auftritt. Röteln verursachen einen typischen feinen, pinkfarbenen Hautausschlag und Fieber.
Erwachsene können schwerere Symptome entwickeln als Kinder. Es gibt keine spezifische Behandlung bei Röteln und gegen etwaiges Fieber sollte Paracetamol oder Ibuprofen gegeben werden. Es wird empfohlen, die Öffentlichkeit (Arbeit, Schule usw.) zu meiden, solange Ansteckungsgefahr besteht. Die meisten Menschen erholen sich innerhalb einer Woche nach Auftreten der Symptome. [1](https://ada.com/de/conditions/rubella/#fn:1 "See Footnote 1")
Finde mehr über Deine Symptome heraus.
## Was ist das Risiko von Röteln?
Röteln werden durch ein Virus verursacht. Dieses wird durch Tröpfchen aus Rachen und Nase über die Luft übertragen. Kinder und Personen, die nicht gegen Röteln geimpft wurden, haben ein erhöhtes Risiko für eine Infektion.
## Was sind Röteln-Symptome?
Das typische Symptom von Röteln ist ein feiner, pinkfarbener Ausschlag
Viele Menschen leiden auch unter geschwollenen Lymphknoten im Gesicht und im Halsbereichleichtem Fieber
Einige Personen können zudem:
  * Kopfschmerzen,
  * Gelenkschmerzen,
  * eine laufende Nase,
  * Husten,
  * Halsschmerzen oder eine
  * [Bindehautentzündung](https://ada.com/de/conditions/viral-conjunctivitis/) haben.


Wenn Du Dir unsicher bist, ob diese Beschwerden auf Dich oder eine andere Person zutreffen, starte eine 
## Wie wird Röteln diagnostiziert?
Die Diagnose erfolgt gewöhnlich basierend auf den Symptomen und einer körperlichen Untersuchung. Eine Blutuntersuchung kann vorgenommen werden, um nach Anzeichen einer kürzlich aufgetretenen Rötelninfektion zu suchen, dies ist jedoch häufig nicht notwendig. [2](https://ada.com/de/conditions/rubella/#fn:2 "See Footnote 2")
## Wie wird Röteln behandelt?
Es gibt keine besondere Behandlung für eine Rötelninfektion. Die Einnahme von Paracetamol oder Ibuprofen kann Kopfschmerzen oder Fieber lindern.
## Was ist die Prognose bei Röteln?
Die meisten Menschen erholen sich innerhalb einer Woche nach Auftreten der Symptome. Zu Komplikationen kommt es nur selten.
Eine Rötelninfektion während der [Schwangerschaft](https://ada.com/de/conditions/pregnancy/) kann schwere Folgen für das ungeborene Kind haben und bis zum Tod führen. Schwangere Frauen, die mit Röteln in Kontakt kommen, insbesondere in den ersten Schwangerschaftswochen, sollten eine etwaige Behandlung und Nachuntersuchung mit dem behandelnden Arzt besprechen.
## Wie kann man Röteln vorbeugen?
Gegen Röteln sind entsprechende Impfungen[Mumps](https://ada.com/de/conditions/mumps/) und Röteln (MMR). Daher kann Rötelninfektionen vorgebeugt werden, indem der empfohlene Impfplan befolgt wird. Betroffene mit Röteln sollten nach Auftreten des Hautausschlags eine Woche lang zuhause bleiben, um andere Menschen nicht anzustecken.
